As a Senior Engineer you own a component or service, from its design and API to its tests and production health, and you mentor other engineers. Responsibilities: • Design, build, test and ship production code every sprint, test-first. • Own a component or service end to end: its design, OpenAPI contract, data model, Playwright test suite, monitoring and runbook. • Write design documents and architecture decision records for your component, and review other engineers' code with rigour and care. • Choose between AWS Lambda and Kubernetes for your workloads, and build and maintain the CI/CD pipeline that ships them. • Lead triage when your component fails, write post-incident reviews and fix the underlying causes. • Build production AI features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, and maintain your component's Claude Code configuration and MCP server. • Explain technical trade-offs to product and delivery colleagues, including colleagues in other regions. • Mentor less experienced engineers and help new joiners become productive quickly. Minimum qualifications: • Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. • 5 years of professional software development in TypeScript and Node.js or Python. • 3 years of experience testing, maintaining or launching production software, and 1 year of experience with software design and architecture. • Experience working in globally distributed teams across time zones, with stakeholders in other regions. • Backend language and craft. You write idiomatic, strictly typed backend code in TypeScript with Node.js or in Python, with runtime validation at service boundaries using Zod or Pydantic. You understand concurrency in your language well enough to recognise blocking work and profile a misbehaving service, and you know NestJS, Fastify or FastAPI in depth. • React and frontend. You choose and justify state-management approaches in React, keep rendering fast through memoisation, lazy loading and code splitting, and meet WCAG AA accessibility on the  features you build. You contribute components to the design system and can build interfaces that stream responses from AI services. • APIs and data formats. You design REST APIs with OpenAPI and own the contract for your service, including versioning, backwards compatibility, idempotency keys, rate limiting and webhooks. You know when to use JSON and when to use Protocol Buffers, and you check schema compatibility automatically in your pipeline. • Data. You design PostgreSQL schemas and change them without downtime, tune slow queries and understand transaction isolation. You model data well in both DynamoDB and MongoDB, use Redis for caching, and choose the right store for each workload with clear reasons. • Asynchronous systems and reliability. You design producers and consumers on queues such as SQS and BullMQ or Celery, with retries, dead-letter queues and idempotent handlers so that at-least-once  delivery is safe. You recognise when these safeguards are needed before anyone asks. • Cloud and platform. You design services on AWS Lambda, with sensible function boundaries, concurrency settings, dead-letter queues and Step Functions or EventBridge where needed, all defined  as code with AWS CDK or SAM. You operate workloads on Kubernetes, including Helm, autoscaling, rollouts and rollbacks, and you choose between serverless and containers for each workload. • Testing and quality. You practise test-driven development and apply it to the design of whole components, not just individual functions. You write integration and contract tests with Testcontainers and own your component's Playwright test suite, including test data, parallel runs and removing flaky tests. • Observability and performance. You instrument services with OpenTelemetry, own the Datadog monitors, alerts and CloudWatch alarms for your component, and lead triage and post-incident reviews  when it fails. You set performance budgets, profile under realistic load, and find memory leaks and blocking work in production. • Security and identity. You implement OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect end to end, including the authorisation-code flow with PKCE and client credentials for service-to-service calls. You design role based access control, rotate secrets and keys, and secure your supply chain with dependency scanning and static analysis in the pipeline. • Architecture and design. You design a service from a short brief, write design documents and architecture decision records that name the trade-offs, and design for backwards compatibility so that  changes do not break the people who depend on your service. • Engineering practices. You work trunk-based with GitHub Flow and hold others to it in code review. You build and maintain CI/CD pipelines, treat every dependency as something to pin and upgrade on a  regular cadence, and write documentation for the people who will read it. AI-first engineering and LLMs. You build production features on the Anthropic and OpenAI APIs, using tool calling, structured output and evaluations, and you track token usage and cost. You maintain the Claude Code configuration for your component, including CLAUDE.md, skills and subagents, and have built an MCP server that exposes your service to AI agents. • Communication, collaboration and initiative. You communicate clearly and concisely, and you explain technical trade-offs to product, design and delivery colleagues in terms they can act on. You understand problems quickly and confirm shared understanding before acting. You collaborate well across locations and time zones, working asynchronously and handing over cleanly. You are proactive: you spot problems before you are asked, propose solutions and improvements of your own, and see them through without waiting for instructions. • Leadership and behaviours. You review others' code with rigour and care, mentor less experienced engineers, and disagree openly when you need to and then commit fully to the decision. You say "I don't know" when you don't, and you dig in until you do. Preferred qualifications: • B.Tech or B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field. • Experience with monorepo tooling such as Nx or Turborepo at scale. • Experience with Kafka and change data capture. • Experience with behaviour-driven development using Cucumber. • Experience with Bigtable. • Experience shipping an AI agent with LangGraph, Google ADK or the Anthropic Agent SDK. • Experience configuring an identity provider such as Okta, Keycloak or Cognito. This is a hands-on security engineering role. The role requires someone who can work directly with product and engineering teams, review designs, assess APIs, run threat models, test systems, coordinate penetration testing, identify vulnerabilities, and help teams remediate issues. The role ensures DTS products, APIs, data collaboration capabilities, AI-enabled workflows, and client-facing services are designed, built, and tested securely. It also owns the practical offensive security and adversarial assurance activity needed to test DTS products from an attacker’s perspective. The Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead will work closely with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Infrastructure, Security Operations, Privacy, Cloud and Platform Security, and the ISMS and Risk Officer to ensure security issues are identified early, fixed effectively, and tracked through governance where required. Key Responsibilities 1. Hands-on Product and Application Security Provide hands-on security support across DTS products and engineering teams. This includes: Reviewing product designs, technical designs, APIs, services, and integrations. Identifying security weaknesses in applications, workflows, and data flows. Advising engineering teams on secure implementation. Supporting secure design decisions during product discovery and delivery. Helping teams resolve security issues pragmatically without creating unnecessary delivery friction. 2. Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) Embed security into the software development lifecycle across DTS. This includes: Defining and applying secure engineering standards. Supporting secure coding practices. Reviewing CI/CD security controls. Supporting SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and container scanning. Helping teams triage, prioritise, and remediate security findings. Working with engineering teams to make security checks practical and repeatable. 3. Threat Modelling and Security Design Reviews Run threat modelling and security design reviews for new and changed capabilities. This includes: Facilitating threat modelling sessions with engineering and product teams. Reviewing authentication and authorization designs. Assessing API exposure, data flows, trust boundaries, and abuse cases. Identifying risks around tenant isolation, privilege escalation, data leakage, and misuse. Documenting key findings, recommendations, and residual risks. 4. Offensive Security and Adversarial Testing Carry out and coordinate offensive security testing across DTS products and platforms. This includes: Performing hands-on security testing of products, APIs, and workflows. Coordinating external penetration tests. Supporting red team and purple team exercises where required. Testing abuse cases and attacker paths. Testing access control, authentication, authorization, and data leakage risks. Validating remediation of security findings. Feeding material risks into the ISMS and Risk Officer for tracking. 5. API, Integration and Data Product Security Provide security assurance for APIs, integrations, and data products. This includes: Reviewing externally exposed APIs and partner integrations. Assessing rate limiting, authorization, tenant isolation, logging, abuse prevention, and data leakage controls. Supporting secure integration between InfoSum, Open Intelligence, Resolve, WPP Open, and third-party platforms. Reviewing data product workflows for misuse, excessive access, or unintended exposure. Working with Privacy Engineering on privacy-sensitive APIs, algorithms, and outputs. 6. AI and Agentic Security Testing Provide hands-on security review and adversarial testing for AI-enabled and agentic capabilities. Testing whether agent permissions can be bypassed or escalated. Assessing action boundaries and human approval points. Working with Identity, AI, and Data Access Governance to validate agent access models. Documenting AI and agentic security risks and remediation actions. 7. Prioritising findings based on exploitability, exposure, data sensitivity, and business impact. Working directly with engineers to define remediation options. Validating that fixes are effective. Supporting exception and risk acceptance decisions where remediation is delayed. Ensuring significant issues are visible through the DTS risk process. 8. Engineering Enablement and Security Coaching Act as a practical security partner to engineering teams. This includes: Providing secure implementation guidance. Creating lightweight security patterns and examples. Coaching engineers on common application, API, and AI security risks. Helping teams understand the “why” behind security requirements. Supporting a culture where security is part of product quality, not a separate approval gate. Key Accountabilities The Product, Application and Offensive Security Lead will be accountable for: Hands-on application and product security support across DTS. Secure SDLC guidance and practical adoption. Threat modelling and security design reviews. API, integration, and data product security reviews. Offensive security and adversarial testing activity. AI and agentic security testing. Vulnerability triage, remediation guidance, and fix validation. Coordination with ISMS/Risk to ensure material risks and exceptions are tracked. Helping engineering teams build secure systems without unnecessary delivery drag. Skills and Experience The successful candidate will have: Strong hands-on experience in application security, product security, offensive security, security engineering, or penetration testing. Good understanding of modern software engineering, APIs, SaaS platforms, distributed systems, and cloud-native applications. Experience with threat modelling and secure design reviews. Practical knowledge of common application and API security risks, including authentication, authorization, tenant isolation, injection, data leakage, privilege escalation, and supply chain risk. Experience using security testing tools and techniques across web applications, APIs, cloud services, and CI/CD pipelines. Familiarity with SAST, DAST, SCA, secrets scanning, dependency scanning, and vulnerability management workflows. Experience working directly with engineers to remediate findings. Understanding of AI and agentic security risks would be highly valuable. Ability to communicate clearly with engineering, product, architecture, security, and leadership stakeholders. A pragmatic, delivery-aware approach to security. Leadership Expectations The Product, Application and Offensive Security Engineer is expected to: Be hands-on and technically credible with engineering teams. Act as a trusted security partner, not just a reviewer or approver. Challenge insecure designs constructively. Help teams find practical ways to reduce risk. Prioritise issues based on real-world exploitability and business impact. Work across multiple DTS product areas without becoming a delivery bottleneck. Escalate material risks clearly through the appropriate governance routes. Promote secure engineering habits through practical guidance and example. Regular threat modelling and security reviews for critical DTS capabilities. Effective offensive and adversarial testing of products, APIs, and workflows. Faster remediation of penetration test and security testing findings. Improved security assurance for AI and agentic workflows. Engineering teams receiving practical, actionable security guidance. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.    For more information, visit WPP.com.   職務概要   コカ・コーラ社を担当するチームにおいて、日々のクライアント対応を担う重要な役割です。社内外のクリエイティブ、戦略、メディア、ソーシャル、デジタル、ショッパーなどの専門チームと密に連携しながら、TVCM、イベント、デジタル、ソーシャル、店頭など多様なタッチポイントを統合したマーケティングキャンペーンの企画・開発・制作をリードしていただきます。世界広告最大手のWPPグループに属するVML & Ogilvy Japanの一員として、クライアントの信頼されるパートナーとなり、ビジネスの成功に貢献することが期待されます。   必要なスキル・経験 総合広告代理店での５年以上の実務経験、または同等のクライアントサービス領域での実務経験 マス広告、オフライン、デジタルなど多様なタッチポイントを織り交ぜた広告ソリューションに携わった経験 クライアントやパートナー企業を含め複数の関係者を巻き込み、プロジェクトを成功に導いた経験 優れたコミュニケーション能力、プレゼンテーション能力 ４年制大学卒業以上 ビジネスレベルの英語力（尚可） 複数人数からなるチームマネジメント経験（尚可）   求める人物像 クライアントのニーズを深く理解し、その実現に全力を尽くす 高い当事者意識を持ち、自発的に業務を推進できる 臆することなくクライアントに戦略的な提案を行い、議論を深めることができる 社内外の関係者と良好なコミュニケーションを図り、円滑な業務遂行を推進できる 新しいツール（AIや新しいプロセス）に柔軟に対応し、それらを活用して新たな広告プロセスを構築する意欲がある   主な職務 戦略的リーダーシップ ストラテジストと連携し、洞察に満ちたブランド戦略やコミュニケーション戦略の立案を推進する。 クライアントやストラテジストと共に、ビジネス目標に沿った精度の高いクリエイティブブリーフを共創し、End to Endで推進する。 ストラテジストならびにコネクションプランナーと連携し、キャンペーン全体における消費者ジャーニー、各ファネル・チャネルの役割、コネクションポイントを定義し、コミュニケーションプランの策定を主導する。 クリエイティビティ クリエイティブチームと連携し、インパクトのある革新的なアイデアの創出を推進する。 優れたクリエイティブアイデアを擁護し、各タッチポイントで最高の水準で実行されるよう導く。 大胆なアイデアが生まれやすい環境作りを支援する。 クライアントおよび外部パートナーとの関係構築 日々のクライアント担当者やシニアステークホルダーと、信頼に基づいた強固な関係を構築・維持する。 クライアントの期待を超えるため、彼らのビジネス、ブランド、社内プロセスを深く理解する。 メディアパートナーやその他外部協力会社と連携し、１つの包括的な体験をまとめ上げ、円滑なキャンペーン実施を確実にする。 チームマネジメント チームメンバーが最高水準のサービスを提供できるよう、day to dayの業務を支援し、モチベーションを高める。 チームメンバーのトレーニングや能力開発のニーズ把握に貢献する。 協力的でポジティブなチーム環境を醸成する。 リーダーシップ 困難な状況に対して問題を前向きに乗り越え、ソリューションファーストのマインドセットを持ってチームを導く。 クライアントやOpen X / Studio X Leadershipのビジョンを深く理解し、トランスフォーメーションを推進するドライバーとなる。 シニアステークホルダーや外部パートナーと協力し、プロジェクトで最良の成果を達成する。 チーム内の模範として、効果的なコミュニケーションと品質へのコミットメントを示す。 グ ロースへの貢献 効果的かつ効率的にチーム運営を行うことができる。 新しいビジネスの機会を視野に入れて行動できる。   Job Overview As the Integration Lead, you will play a crucial client-facing role within the team dedicated to the Coca-Cola account. You will lead the planning, development, and production of integrated marketing campaigns across various touchpoints—including TVC, events, digital, social and shopper — by collaborating closely with internal and external specialist teams such as creative, strategy, media, social, digital, and shopper. As a member of VML & Ogilvy Japan, part of the WPP network, you are expected to become a trusted partner to the client and contribute to their business success.   Qualifications Minimum 5 years of experience in a full-service advertising agency or equivalent client service experience. Experience in integrated solutions across multiple touchpoints such as mass advertising, offline, and digital. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple stakeholders, including clients and partner companies, and lead projects to successful completion. Excellent communication and presentation skills. Bachelor's degree or above. Business level English proficiency (preferred). Experience managing a team of multiple people (preferred).   Who you are Deeply understands client needs and is committed to making their objectives a reality. A self-starter with a strong sense of ownership. Confidently presents strategic proposals to clients and fosters constructive discussions. Effectively communicates with internal and external stakeholders to ensure smooth project execution. Adaptable to new tools (e.g., AI, new processes) and motivated to leverage them to build new ways of work.   Key Accountabilities Strategic Leadership Partner with strategists to drive the creation of insightful brand and communication strategies. Co-create quality creative briefs that answer business goals alongside clients and strategists and execute the briefs through end-to-end consumer journey. In collaboration with strategists and connection planners, define the consumer journey, the role of each funnel and channel, and key connection points to lead the development of the overall communication plan. Creativity Partner with creative teams to drive the creation of impactful and innovative ideas. Champion excellent creative ideas and guide their execution to the highest standard at every touchpoint. Help create an environment where bold ideas can flourish. Client Management and External Parties Build and maintain strong, trusted relationships with day-to-day clients and senior stakeholders. Develop a deep understanding of the client’s business, brand, and internal processes to exceed their expectations. Liaise with media partners and other external collaborators to orchestrate a single, comprehensive experience and ensure seamless campaign implementation. Team Management Support and motivate team members in their day-to-day tasks, to deliver the highest standard of service. Contribute to identifying team members' training and development needs. Foster a collaborative and positive team environment. Leadership Lead the team through challenging situations with a positive, solution-first mindset. Become a key driver of transformation by deeply understanding and promoting the vision of the client and Open X / Studio X Leadership. Partner with senior stakeholders and external partners to achieve the best project outcomes. Serve as a role model within the team, demonstrating effective communication and a commitment to quality. Contribution to Growth Be responsible for managing the team efficiently and effectively. Actively identify and pursue new business opportunities.   About Us 会社概要 VML & Ogilvy Japan GK was established in April 2019 as a partnership between Geometry Global and The Ogilvy Group to enhance our offering to brands in Japan in support of their business ambitions and marketing objectives. We believe in the power of creativity to drive meaningful change that delivers positive business outcomes. Now more than ever the ability for an agency to flex and adapt to clients changing needs is vital in the application of communications, brand experience, commerce and technology. Our blend of global and local expertise and marketing capability is designed to meet the challenges of today while setting our clients up for success from tomorrow and beyond. VML & Ogilvy Japan GK is a WPP company (NASDAQ: WWPGY). VML & Ogilvy Japan GK embraces and celebrates diversity, inclusivity, and equal opportunity. We are committed to building a team that represents a variety of backgrounds, perspectives, and skills. We are a worldwide creative agency that represents global clients. The more inclusive we are, the more brilliant work we can create together.     Not sure if you have what it takes? We encourage you to apply if you think you’d be a great candidate for this position—even if you may not have all the desired qualifications We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. That's why we’ve adopted a hybrid approach, with teams in the office around four days a week. title: VML & Ogilvy | Senior Social Strategist, Japan
description: WPP is the trusted growth partner for the world’s leading brands.  We unite cutting-edge media intelligence and data solutions, world-class creativity, next-generation production, transformative enterprise solutions and expert strategic counsel in a single company – powered by exceptional talent and our agentic marketing platform, WPP Open, to help our clients navigate change, capture opportunity and deliver transformational growth.    We work with the world's most valuable brands and have global reach across 100+ markets, with deep local expertise.   Our people are the key to our success. We're committed to fostering a culture of creativity, belonging and continuous learning, attracting and developing the brightest talent, and providing exciting career opportunities that help our people grow.    For more information, visit WPP.com.   The Role You will be a key social and influencer strategist. A strategist who lives inside platforms, reads culture in real time, and translates signals into ideas that move both the brand and the business. You will shape social and influencer strategies for always-on programs and integrated campaigns across Instagram, X, TikTok, LINE, YouTube and emerging platforms. You will connect organic, paid, owned and earned media into one cohesive ecosystem while ensuring strategies remain insight-led, platform-native and aligned with broader business and marketing objectives. You will work closely with clients, creative, production, media, analytics and external partners to translate strategy into execution, ensuring every piece of work delivers measurable business impact. You will use social tools, AI, and data to build smarter workflows, stronger insights and faster delivery. This role suits someone who is strategic, hands-on, commercially minded and passionate about helping brands grow through social and influencer marketing. You will be expected to take ownership of strategic workstreams and lead projects from strategy through execution, while collaborating closely with cross-functional teams across the business. Someone who thrives in ambiguity, simplifies complexity and consistently raises the quality of work around them. You work well with people, and you work well on your own. You think. You do. You deliver. Key Responsibilities Social Strategy Lead the development of integrated social and influencer strategies for always-on programs and campaigns aligned with business and brand objectives. Contribute to quarterly and annual strategic planning in partnership with clients and internal teams. Define the role of each social platform across Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube and emerging channels. Connect organic, paid, owned and earned media into one cohesive strategy. Translate business challenges, consumer insights and cultural trends into clear strategic direction and actionable creative briefs. Ensure strategic consistency across platforms while enabling culturally relevant and platform-native executions. Use AI and social intelligence tools to sharpen insights, uncover opportunities and accelerate delivery. Influencer Strategy & Partnerships Develop influencer activation strategies that align with the overall social strategy. Define creator roles, content territories, platform mix and activation approaches for each campaign. Develop creator selection criteria balancing audience relevance, credibility, reach and engagement. Partner closely with influencer agencies, creator platforms and external partners to ensure strategic alignment and execution quality. Develop influencer briefing principles, content guardrails and approval workflows that protect brand quality and consistency. Identify opportunities for social-first innovation, emerging creators, new platforms and strategic partnerships. Develop measurement plans and learning agendas for campaigns. Track performance through weekly, monthly, quarterly and annual reporting. Partner with analytics teams to interpret brand and campaign performance. Present actionable insights, performance reviews and optimization recommendations to clients. Use social listening, trend analysis, AI and audience data to guide content and strategic decisions. Turn insights into practical recommendations that improve future performance. Creative & Production Collaboration Translate approved strategies into clear, inspiring creative briefs. Partner with creative teams to shape platform-native ideas and content systems. Guide storytelling, content formats, creator partnerships and channel recommendations. Brief copywriters, designers, creators and production teams to ensure alignment with the strategic intent. Provide strategic guidance throughout content production and campaign development to maintain alignment with business objectives and platform best practices. Review creative output and ensure deliverables meet both strategic and creative expectations before client presentation. Client & Cross-functional Collaboration Serve as a trusted social and influencer strategy partner for clients throughout the lifecycle of a project. Lead strategic discussions within projects and confidently present recommendations, insights and future opportunities to clients. Share platform updates, cultural trends, thought leadership and best practices with clients and internal teams. Work collaboratively across account, creative, media, production, analytics and research teams to deliver integrated solutions. Support regional and global initiatives by adapting global strategies into locally relevant execution. Build trusted relationships with local and global stakeholders to ensure smooth collaboration across markets. Take ownership of the strategic workstream from briefing through optimization while ensuring alignment across all project stakeholders. What You Bring Experience 8–10+ years of experience in social strategy, influencer strategy or integrated digital marketing. Proven experience developing and delivering social and influencer strategies for major brands. Strong understanding of Instagram, TikTok, X, LINE, YouTube and emerging platforms. Experience working across organic, paid, owned and earned media. Experience collaborating with creative, production, media and analytics teams throughout campaign development. Experience working with regional or global stakeholders is highly desirable. Strong client presentation, facilitation and stakeholder management skills. Craft Fluent in consumer insight, social strategy and content planning. Strong understanding of influencer ecosystems and creator marketing. Able to build strategic frameworks that connect business objectives to creative execution. Skilled in social listening, trend analysis and performance measurement. Strong at translating data into actionable business recommendations. Comfortable using AI tools, prompt engineering, and automation to improve efficiency and quality. Mindset Curious, commercially minded and solutions-oriented. Thinks strategically while remaining highly hands-on. Comfortable switching between long-term planning and day-to-day execution. Confident working across cross-functional teams and leading projects in fast-paced environments. Collaborative, proactive and accountable. Passionate about growing clients' businesses and strengthening the Content Studio's strategic capability.   Language Requirements Professional proficiency in both Japanese and English. #LI-DNP We believe the best work happens when we're together, fostering creativity, collaboration, and connection. title: AI Specialist - Enterprise Decision Management
description: ABOUT CAPCO Capco, a Wipro company, is a global management and technology consultancy specialising in driving digital transformation across the financial services industry. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, Capco combines innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to fast-track initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, and insurance. Our ingenuity is brought to life through our Innovation Labs, award-winning Be Yourself at Work culture, and a diverse, talented team across more than 30 offices worldwide. ROLE DESCRIPTION Every consequential moment in financial services — approving a policy, extending credit, flagging a transaction, recommending a portfolio — is a decision. The best financial institutions do not leave those decisions to chance, intuition, or inconsistent human judgement. They engineer them: combining predictive analytics, business rules, and optimisation into decision services that are fast, consistent, auditable, and continuously improving. That discipline is Enterprise Decision Management. As an AI Specialist in Enterprise Decision Management, you will lead the design and delivery of intelligent decision automation solutions for Capco's financial services clients across Asia. You will help clients move beyond point-in-time analytics and disconnected AI engines toward closed-loop decision systems: where predictive models inform rules, rules govern actions, outcomes are measured, and both models and rules are continuously refined as a result. This role demands genuine depth across the full AI and decision management spectrum — from classical techniques such as expert systems, case-based reasoning, and scorecards, through to modern machine learning, optimisation, and large language model integration. We are not looking for generalists who discovered AI in the last few years. We are looking for practitioners who have spent a career building, deploying, and improving intelligent decision systems in production financial services environments. Think of this as a forward-deployed role: you will be embedded with clients, building working solutions alongside their teams, and leaving behind capabilities that outlast the engagement. You will also play a defining role in building Capco's Enterprise Decision Management practice across Asia. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Decision Strategy & Architecture Lead the design of end-to-end Enterprise Decision Management (EDM) architectures — connecting data ingestion, predictive model scoring, business rule execution, decision optimisation, and outcome measurement into coherent, production-grade decision services. Advise clients on decision strategy: identifying which decisions to automate, which to augment, and which to keep in human hands — and designing the governance frameworks to manage each appropriately. Model and decompose complex financial services decision domains — underwriting, claims adjudication, credit and affordability assessment, client suitability, fraud detection, and regulatory compliance — into structured decision architectures using DMN and related standards. Define the feedback loops and monitoring frameworks that allow decision systems to learn from outcomes — closing the loop between prediction, decision, action, and measurement. Predictive Analytics & Optimisation Design and oversee the development of predictive models — including scorecards, logistic regression, gradient boosting, and neural network approaches — that feed directly into operational decision flows. Apply prescriptive analytics and mathematical optimisation techniques (linear programming, constraint optimisation, genetic algorithms) to maximise decision outcomes at portfolio or population level, not just at the individual transaction level. Advise on champion/challenger frameworks, model validation approaches, and the governance of model changes within live decision systems — ensuring clients meet MAS, HKMA, and internal model risk management requirements. Apply classical AI techniques — expert systems, case-based reasoning, Bayesian inference — where they are the most appropriate and explainable tool for a given decision problem. Rules Engineering & Decision Automation Distinguish clearly between rule engine integration concerns (deployment architecture, service exposure, API design, DevOps pipelines for rules) and rule service design concerns (authoring, testing, governance, and versioning of business logic) — and bring demonstrated expertise in both. Design the interfaces between predictive model outputs and rules engine inputs — ensuring that model scores, segments, and recommendations are consumed correctly within decision flows and that the combined output is auditable. Modern AI Integration Integrate decision management capabilities with LLM and generative AI architectures — including patterns such as rules-based guardrails over LLM outputs, LLM-driven document understanding feeding structured rule evaluation, and conversational interfaces over decision services. Advise clients on where deterministic, rules-based approaches and probabilistic, model-based approaches are best combined — and design hybrid architectures that preserve the auditability and consistency that regulated financial services require. Practice & Client Development Drive business development activities including proposals, RFP responses, client workshops, and thought leadership on decision intelligence and AI in financial services. Mentor junior and mid-level team members and contribute actively to building Capco's decision intelligence practice, intellectual property, and accelerators across Asia KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Deliver robust, production-ready decision management solutions that demonstrably improve client decision quality, speed, consistency, and measurability. Ensure decision systems meet the governance, auditability, explainability, and model risk requirements of financial services regulators across Asia-Pacific, including MAS and HKMA guidelines on the use of AI in decision-making. Maintain and grow senior client relationships, acting as a trusted long-term advisor on decision intelligence strategy and roadmap. Uphold Capco's standards of quality, integrity, and professionalism across all client engagements. Contribute measurably to Capco Asia's decision management practice through reusable assets, methodology development, and external thought leadership. THE PREFERRED CANDIDATE WILL Have spent a decade or more building, deploying, and evolving intelligent decision systems in financial services — with a track record that spans the full EDM lifecycle from predictive model development through to rules-driven operational execution and outcome measurement. Understand the complete toolbox of AI techniques available for decision problems — classical and modern — and have the experience and intellectual honesty to choose the right tool rather than default to whichever approach is currently receiving the most attention. Be as fluent discussing scorecard development, Gini coefficients, and population stability indices as they are discussing transformer architectures, prompt engineering, and RAG pipelines. Have deep domain expertise in insurance and/or wealth management decision logic, with secondary familiarity in banking or capital markets. Be comfortable operating as a senior individual contributor, a client-facing advisor, and a practice builder — often simultaneously. Thrive in Capco's flat, non-hierarchical culture and bring an entrepreneurial spirit to the challenge of building a high-value, differentiated capability in Asia. MANDATORY SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE Business & Domain Minimum 10 years of experience in decision management, AI engineering, or a closely related analytical discipline within financial services. Proven track record of delivering Enterprise Decision Management solutions in production environments — combining predictive analytics, optimisation, and business rules within operational decision flows. Strong domain knowledge in insurance and/or wealth management: underwriting decision logic, claims assessment, policy eligibility, suitability frameworks, KYC/AML rules, or client segmentation and next-best-action engines. Experience advising senior stakeholders — Chief Analytics Officers, Chief Risk Officers, Chief Data Officers — on decision automation strategy and the business case for intelligent decisioning investments. Technical — Decision Management & Classical AI Hands-on experience with enterprise BRMS platforms in production: IBM Operational Decision Manager (ODM), FICO Blaze Advisor, Red Hat Decision Manager (RHDM), or IBM Drools — with the ability to distinguish and lead on both rule engine integration and rule service design. Proficiency in decision modelling standards: DMN (Decision Model and Notation), PMML (Predictive Model Markup Language), and their use in documenting, governing, and exchanging decision and model assets. Practical experience designing and implementing expert systems, including forward and backward chaining inference, Rete algorithm optimisation, and rule conflict resolution strategies. Working knowledge of case-based reasoning (CBR), Bayesian networks, constraint satisfaction, and genetic and evolutionary algorithms — with experience applying these techniques to real financial services problems. Experience designing and building traditional credit or insurance scorecards, including feature engineering, binning, weight-of-evidence encoding, logistic regression, and scorecard scaling. Proficiency in decision optimisation: linear and integer programming, constraint-based optimisation, and the application of optimisation to portfolio-level decision problems such as collections strategy, offer optimisation, or risk-based pricing. Technical — Predictive Modelling & Modern AI Working knowledge of machine learning model development, validation, and deployment lifecycle — including gradient boosting (XGBoost, LightGBM), ensemble methods, and neural networks. Experience designing champion/challenger frameworks, model monitoring pipelines, and population stability analysis for models operating within live decision systems. Working knowledge of LLM capabilities and limitations, with practical experience designing hybrid decision architectures that combine deterministic rule engines with generative AI components. Familiarity with AI explainability techniques (SHAP, LIME, counterfactual explanations) and their application in regulated financial services decision contexts. Experience with model risk management frameworks and the documentation requirements of MAS FEAT principles, HKMA guidance on AI, or equivalent regulatory standards. PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE Experience with real-time and event-driven decision architectures, including complex event processing (CEP), streaming decision services, and sub-second decisioning requirements. Exposure to insurance platform ecosystems (Guidewire, Duck Creek, Majesco) or wealth platform ecosystems (Avaloq, FNZ, iCapital) and their integration with external decision and analytics services. Knowledge of process and decision automation platforms (Pega, Camunda, Appian) and how their native rules capabilities relate to — and differ from — dedicated BRMS platforms. Prior experience working across Singapore and Hong Kong markets, with an appreciation for the regulatory and competitive dynamics shaping AI adoption in both jurisdictions. Published thought leadership, conference presentations, or open-source contributions in the decision management, AI, or predictive analytics space. WHY JOIN CAPCO? You will work at the cutting edge of intelligent decision automation in financial services, with clients who are genuinely committed to transforming how they make decisions at scale. At Capco you will find: A work culture focused on innovation and building lasting value for clients and colleagues alike. Ongoing learning and development opportunities to deepen your expertise and grow as a recognised leader in enterprise decision management. A flat, non-hierarchical structure that enables you to work directly with senior partners and client executives from day one. A diverse, inclusive, and meritocratic culture where your depth of expertise and real-world impact define your reputation. The backing of a globally recognised brand and the resources of Wipro, combined with the agility and entrepreneurial spirit of a boutique consultancy.

Analyse impacts across products, processes, systems, data, controls and customer journeys. Support solution design and evaluate proposed solutions against business requirements. Identify upstream and downstream impacts and dependencies across banking processes and platforms. Stakeholder & Delivery Collaboration Act as a key bridge between business, operations and technology teams throughout the transformation lifecycle. Build trusted relationships with client stakeholders and facilitate effective decision-making. Communicate complex requirements clearly across both business and technical audiences. Work closely with Project Managers, Product Owners, developers, architects, testers and other delivery stakeholders. Support SIT, UAT and business validation activities, ensuring delivered solutions meet agreed requirements. Manage defects and requirement clarifications through to resolution. Support implementation planning, business readiness and transition into BAU. Validate delivered outcomes against the original business objectives and requirements. Consulting & Client Delivery Produce high-quality consulting deliverables, including analysis, recommendations, presentations and executive materials. Structure complex problems and communicate findings clearly to client stakeholders. Contribute insights and recommendations rather than simply documenting stakeholder requests. Support development of business cases, transformation roadmaps and client proposals where required. Coach and support junior Business Analysts and contribute to Capco methodologies and reusable assets. What We're Looking For Demonstrated experience as a Business Analyst / Senior Business Analyst within banking or financial services. Proven experience working on banking transformation programmes, including business, digital, technology, operating model or regulatory transformation. Strong experience across requirements elicitation, business analysis, process mapping, gap analysis and functional requirements. Strong understanding of the end-to-end change lifecycle, from discovery and requirements through design, testing and implementation. Experience working across business and technology teams within complex banking environments. Ability to understand the business problem behind a requirement and challenge or refine requirements where appropriate. Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, including experience running workshops and engaging senior stakeholders. Excellent analytical, problem-solving and communication skills. Ability to operate effectively in complex, ambiguous and highly regulated environments. Banking Domain Experience Candidates should bring strong experience in at least one banking domain , such as: Retail Banking Private Banking / Wealth Management Corporate / Commercial Banking Transaction Banking / Cash Management Payments / Payment Platforms Capital Markets / Markets Digital Banking / Banking Channels Core Banking Risk & Regulatory Change Data & Reporting Other relevant banking products or functions We value depth of experience within a banking domain over exposure to every area listed above. Why Join Capco? At Capco, you'll have the opportunity to build your career at the intersection of banking, transformation and consulting, working on complex challenges that matter to our clients. You'll have the opportunity to: Work with leading banks and financial institutions on high-impact transformation programmes. Deepen your expertise within your banking domain while gaining exposure to new transformation challenges. Work directly with senior business and technology stakeholders. Develop broader consulting capabilities beyond traditional Business Analysis. Gain exposure to different clients, programmes and banking environments. Join a growing Malaysia practice within a globally connected financial services consultancy. Work in an entrepreneurial culture where ownership, collaboration and new ideas are encouraged.

Support mock migrations, cutover planning, go-live readiness assessments, and production validation. Maintain implementation documentation, issue logs, requirements traceability, and status reporting Stakeholder and Client Management Collaborate with traders, trading operations, risk managers, schedulers, finance teams, and IT stakeholders. Facilitate requirements workshops, process walkthroughs, solution demonstrations, and design discussions. Strong understanding of physical and/or financial commodities trading and associated business processes. Experience in requirements gathering, fit-gap analysis, functional design, configuration support, and testing. Understanding of the commodities trade lifecycle and its interaction with risk, operations, logistics, finance, and settlement. Experience preparing BRDs, functional specifications, process maps, user stories, test cases, and implementation documentation. We help banks, insurers, and capital markets firms navigate complex change across transformation, technology, risk & compliance, and strategy. With a strong and growing presence across Asia‑Pacific, including Malaysia, Capco partners with some of the world’s largest financial institutions on high‑impact, large‑scale transformation initiatives. Our consultants combine deep industry expertise with innovative thinking to deliver measurable outcomes for clients. As we continue to scale rapidly in Malaysia, this is an exciting time to join Capco. You’ll have the opportunity to make a real impact, build new capabilities, and grow your career quickly within a collaborative, high‑performance consulting environment. About the Opportunity We are seeking an experienced Cards Migration Consultant to support a large-scale credit card portfolio migration programme within the banking and payments sector. This is a hands-on transformation delivery role requiring strong card issuing and payments expertise, combined with the ability to manage complex migration workstreams and engage senior stakeholders. The successful candidate will support the planning and execution of a credit card portfolio migration across payment schemes, helping to ensure operational readiness, effective stakeholder coordination and minimal customer disruption. Key Responsibilities Lead designated card migration workstreams, including planning, milestones, deliverables and dependencies. Support migration strategy, portfolio segmentation, migration waves and execution sequencing. Coordinate card product mapping across features, pricing, rewards, benefits and customer propositions. Work with business, technology, operations, risk, fraud, compliance and finance stakeholders to resolve migration dependencies. Manage workstream risks, issues, actions and implementation readiness. Support migration cutover preparation and post-migration stabilisation. Assess customer and operational impacts, including potential service disruption and customer attrition. Facilitate workshops, stakeholder discussions and decision-making sessions. Prepare programme updates, implementation roadmaps and steering committee materials. Requirements Approximately 8–10 years of relevant experience in cards, payments, banking transformation, consulting or programme delivery. Proven experience delivering or leading cards, payments or payment scheme migration programmes. Strong understanding of the card issuing ecosystem, including payment processing, authorisation, clearing and settlement. Experience managing complex, cross-functional programmes involving multiple stakeholders and vendors. Strong analytical, problem-solving, stakeholder management and communication capabilities. Ability to prepare clear, decision-oriented materials for senior management. Advantageous Experience Payment scheme migrations, BIN migrations or core card platform transformations. Card operations, fraud, risk, customer servicing, rewards or loyalty programmes. Regional or multi-market banking transformation initiatives. PMP, PRINCE2, Agile or equivalent project management certification. The Ideal Candidate You have practical experience delivering complex card migration or card issuing transformation initiatives. You understand both the technical and operational considerations involved in migrating card portfolios and can translate programme objectives into structured, executable workstreams. You are comfortable working across business and technology teams, managing delivery dependencies and communicating with senior stakeholders.

title: Change Management Consultant
description: Change Management Consultant Location: Houston, Texas | Practice Area: Business Consulting | Type: Permanent Help clients turn complex transformation into change that people can understand, adopt, and sustain. The Role At Capco, we help our clients navigate complex business and technology transformations. Our consultants work alongside client teams to solve critical challenges, enable meaningful change, and deliver sustainable business outcomes. As a Change Management Consultant , you’ll work at the intersection of people, process, and technology, supporting organizations as they prepare for, adopt, and sustain change across large-scale transformation initiatives. You’ll take ownership of defined change management activities and deliverables, build trusted relationships with client stakeholders, and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a fast-paced consulting environment. Your work may span digital and technology implementations, operating model change, process improvement, organizational redesign, mergers and acquisitions, and workforce transformation. What You’ll Do Develop and execute change management strategies and plans for complex business and technology transformation initiatives, applying Prosci methodologies and the ADKAR model where appropriate. Conduct stakeholder, change impact and readiness assessments, translating findings into practical engagement and mitigation strategies. Develop targeted communications, training and enablement activities that build awareness, understanding, commitment and adoption across impacted stakeholder groups. Partner with client leaders, managers, project teams and subject matter experts to identify change risks, address resistance and strengthen leadership alignment. Facilitate workshops, interviews and working sessions, while defining and tracking change readiness, engagement, adoption and effectiveness measures. What We’re Looking For Bachelor’s degree in Business, Organizational Development, Human Resources, Psychology, Communications or a related field, together with Prosci Change Management Certification . 2–5 years of experience in change management, organizational effectiveness, business transformation, management consulting or a related discipline. Experience supporting enterprise-wide transformations or technology implementations, with practical knowledge of stakeholder engagement, change impact assessment, communications, training, readiness and adoption. Strong analytical, problem-solving, written, verbal, presentation and facilitation skills, with the ability to turn complex business challenges into actionable change strategies. Ability to build effective relationships across organizational levels, manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality work in a client-facing environment, including client-site work and travel as required. Bonus Points For Experience within a management consulting or professional services environment. Experience supporting ERP, CRM, cloud, AI, digital, operating model or workforce transformation initiatives. Experience working within Financial Services, Energy, Healthcare, Retail or Public Sector organizations. Knowledge of Agile delivery and project management methodologies and experience supporting complex cross-functional business and technology programs. Additional relevant certifications such as PMP, CCMP, Agile, Scrum or Lean Six Sigma. Why Join Capco Work on complex business and technology transformations with leading organizations. Collaborate in a flat, entrepreneurial consulting culture where different perspectives are valued. Build your consulting and change management capabilities through challenging client engagements. Work alongside experienced consultants and client leaders across multidisciplinary transformation teams. Make an impact by helping organizations successfully adopt and sustain meaningful change. Benefits We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life: Medical, dental and vision coverage. 401(k) match and HSA/FSA options. Maternity and paternity leave and dependent care benefits. Tuition reimbursement and wellness reimbursement. Commuter benefits and access to Working Advantage, a discounted marketplace. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day. title: Change Management Consultant – Banking & Wealth Transformation
description: About Capco Capco is a global business and technology consultancy dedicated to the financial services industry. We combine deep industry expertise with consulting and transformation capabilities to help leading financial institutions navigate complex change and deliver meaningful outcomes. Across APAC and globally, we partner with banks and financial institutions on programmes spanning business transformation, digital and technology change, operating model transformation, regulatory change and large-scale programme delivery. As we continue to grow our Malaysia practice, we are looking for experienced change professionals who can help our clients successfully navigate transformation — ensuring stakeholders are engaged, impacted teams are prepared, and change is effectively embedded across the organisation. Role Overview We are looking for an experienced Change Management Consultant with a strong Banking and/or Wealth Management background to support complex transformation programmes across our financial services clients. You will be responsible for understanding the people and organisational impacts of transformation and developing structured change approaches that enable successful adoption. The role requires a strong combination of change management, stakeholder engagement and communications expertise, alongside sufficient banking domain knowledge to understand the business context in which change is taking place. You will work closely with senior business stakeholders, programme leadership, technology and delivery teams to assess change impacts, identify stakeholder needs, develop communications and engagement strategies, and support the organisation through transition and implementation. This is a hands-on, client-facing consulting role suited to someone who can navigate complex stakeholder environments, bring structure to change, and communicate effectively across different levels of an organisation. What You'll Do Change Strategy & Planning Develop and execute change management strategies and plans aligned to programme objectives and business outcomes. Assess the scale, complexity and organisational impact of proposed changes. Define appropriate change interventions across different stakeholder and impacted-user groups. Develop integrated change plans covering stakeholder engagement, communications, readiness, adoption and implementation activities. Partner with programme leadership to ensure change considerations are embedded throughout the transformation lifecycle. Change Impact & Readiness Conduct change impact assessments to understand how transformation will affect people, processes, roles, systems and ways of working. Identify impacted stakeholder groups and assess the nature and significance of change across the organisation. Conduct readiness assessments and identify potential barriers to adoption. Develop appropriate mitigation and intervention plans to address identified change risks. Track change readiness and adoption throughout implementation. Stakeholder Management & Engagement Conduct stakeholder identification, analysis and mapping across complex banking organisations. Develop tailored stakeholder engagement strategies based on influence, impact and change needs. Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, business leaders and programme teams. Facilitate stakeholder interviews, workshops, working sessions and engagement forums. Identify stakeholder concerns, resistance and dependencies and work with programme leadership to address them. Support senior sponsors and change champions in effectively leading and communicating change. Communications Management Develop and execute change communication strategies and plans across transformation programmes. Define key messages, audiences, communication channels and sequencing. Develop high-quality communications materials including leadership communications, programme updates, briefing materials, FAQs and presentations. Tailor communications for different stakeholder populations and levels of the organisation. Ensure communications remain aligned with programme milestones, business priorities and change objectives. Monitor communication effectiveness and adjust approaches where required. Adoption & Business Readiness Support business teams in preparing for implementation and transition to new processes, systems or ways of working. Coordinate change activities with project, business, operations and technology teams. Support training-needs analysis and coordinate with learning/training teams where required. Develop and monitor change adoption and readiness measures. Support post-implementation activities to help embed change and identify areas requiring additional intervention. Consulting & Client Delivery Produce high-quality consulting deliverables, including change assessments, stakeholder maps, communications plans, change roadmaps and executive presentations. Provide structured insights and recommendations to client stakeholders. Facilitate discussions and workshops with senior stakeholders across business and technology. Work collaboratively with Project Managers, Business Analysts, Product Owners and other transformation specialists. Contribute to Capco's change management methodologies, propositions and reusable assets. What We're Looking For Demonstrated experience in Change Management, Organisational Change or Business Transformation, ideally within banking or financial services. Hands-on experience developing and delivering change management strategies and plans across transformation programmes. Strong experience in stakeholder management and engagement, including working with senior stakeholders. Strong communications management capabilities, including development of communication strategies, plans, messaging and executive materials. Experience conducting change impact assessments, stakeholder assessments and business readiness activities. Experience supporting transformation from planning through implementation and adoption. Strong facilitation, communication and presentation skills. Ability to operate effectively in complex and ambiguous transformation environments. Strong consulting mindset, with the ability to structure problems, challenge constructively and develop practical recommendations. Banking Domain Experience Candidates should bring meaningful experience within Banking and/or Wealth Management, ideally gained through transformation programmes involving areas such as: Private Banking / Wealth Management Retail Banking Corporate / Commercial Banking Transaction Banking / Payments Digital Banking Banking Operations Customer / Relationship Manager journeys Technology or platform transformation Operating model transformation We value strong change management capability combined with genuine banking domain exposure over experience across every area listed above. Advantageous Experience Previous experience within management consulting, transformation consulting or professional services. Experience supporting large-scale or regional banking/wealth transformation programmes. Experience working across multiple markets or geographically distributed stakeholder groups. Exposure to digital, technology, platform or operating model transformation. Familiarity with established change methodologies such as Prosci / ADKAR, Kotter or equivalent frameworks. Experience developing change networks, champion programmes or leadership engagement approaches. Change Management certification would be advantageous but is not essential. Why Join Capco? At Capco, you'll have the opportunity to work at the intersection of banking, transformation and people change, helping leading financial institutions successfully navigate complex change. You'll have the opportunity to: Work on high-impact banking and wealth transformation programmes. Partner directly with senior client stakeholders and programme leadership. Apply and deepen your expertise across change management, stakeholder engagement and communications. Gain exposure to different clients, transformation challenges and banking domains. Build broader consulting capabilities within a globally connected financial services consultancy. Join a growing Malaysia practice where ownership, collaboration and new ideas are encouraged.

title: Comprador - Remoto
description: SOBRE A CAPCO A CAPCO é uma consultoria global de tecnologia e negócios, focada no setor de serviços financeiros e energia, somos apaixonados por ajudar nossos clientes, temos 33 escritórios nas Américas, Europa e Ásia-Pacífico! ATRIBUIÇÃO   - Receber, analisar, monitorar e tratar as RCs, para posterior emissão e envio do PC ou devolução da RC à área responsável, em caso de necessidade de complemento e/ou correção, com base nos parâmetros e orientações definidas pela PETROBRAS; - Verificar e corrigir e/ou reportar às áreas responsáveis eventuais inconsistências nas RCs novas e devolvidas; - Enviar o PC ao fornecedor, e aguardar seu aceite, tomando todas as ações necessárias até que o PC seja enviado de acordo com as condições contratadas ao fornecedor; - Acompanhar, analisar e apresentar relatório semanal com a situação das RCs que tiveram os respectivos PCs emitidos automaticamente pelo SATRe (materiais, quantidade, fornecedor, contrato, status do envio e aceite pelo fornecedor dentre as informações que a PETROBRAS solicitar); Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities within a consulting environment. MAKE AN IMPACT Role: GCP Data Engineer  Job Summary: We are looking for an enthusiastic GCP Data Engineer to join our dynamic and growing project team. title: Generative AI Engineer
description: Joining Capco means joining an organisation that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you’re encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can and we believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Such differences may mean we need to make changes to our process to allow you the best possible platform to succeed, and we are happy to cater to any reasonable adjustments you may require. You will find the section to let us know of these at the bottom of your application form or you can mention it directly to your recruiter at any stage and they will be happy to help. About Capco Capco is a global technology and business consultancy, focused on the financial services sector. We are growing at fast pace in our Italian office, the opportunity for growth is large, accessible, and immediate. We are passionate about helping our clients succeed in an ever-changing industry. Capco is going through a significant growth journey, now is a very good time to join us as we expand our consulting team in Italy. Role Description: We are looking for a Generative AI Engineer to join the Capco AI Lab and help design and build production-grade AI solutions for our clients. This is a hands-on engineering role for someone with a strong software engineering background and expertise in Generative and Agentic AI. You will contribute to technical and architectural decisions and, importantly, write and review production code . You will work on complex AI systems covering LLM orchestration, AI agents, RAG, tool and function calling, evaluation and observability, taking solutions from early prototypes through to scalable production environments. The role also involves collaborating directly with clients, translating business requirements into robust technical solutions and contributing to discussions on AI architecture, platforms and technology choices. Responsibilities Design and contribute to the end-to-end architecture of Generative and Agentic AI solutions , including orchestration, AI agents, tool/function calling, RAG, memory and state management. Remain hands-on with software development , building complex components and taking prototypes through to production-grade solutions. Apply engineering standards and best practices for AI applications, including reference architectures, testing and evaluation strategies, guardrails, observability and CI/CD. Design scalable, secure and reliable AI systems, considering performance, latency, cost, monitoring and production requirements. Evaluate and recommend appropriate LLMs, frameworks, platforms and tools based on technical and business requirements. Participate in technical design and code reviews, collaborate with other engineers and contribute to maintaining high engineering standards across the team. Work directly with clients and stakeholders to translate business requirements into technical solutions and clearly communicate technical decisions and trade-offs. Contribute to technical documentation, reference architectures and knowledge sharing around Generative and Agentic AI. Skills and Experience Essential skills to succeed Professional experience in Software Engineering/Backend Engineering, including experience designing and building enterprise-grade systems. Strong hands-on software engineering skills and experience writing high-quality production code with Python. Demonstrable experience designing and developing LLM and Agentic AI applications, including AI agents, LLM orchestration and tool/function calling. Strong understanding of RAG architectures, retrieval approaches and vector-based search. Experience with agentic frameworks and integration approaches such as LangChain, LangGraph, MCP or comparable technologies. Understanding of how to test and evaluate non-deterministic AI systems, including LLM/agent evaluation, monitoring and observability. Strong software architecture and engineering fundamentals, including APIs, distributed systems, integration patterns and production reliability. Strong experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP) and cloud-native engineering practices. Experience with modern software engineering and DevOps practices, including containers and CI/CD. Experience with Infrastructure as Code and observability is highly valued. Experience contributing to architecture/design reviews and code reviews, while remaining actively involved in engineering and development. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly and confidently to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Solid professional English. Bonus points Experience with multi-agent architectures, advanced RAG, AI evaluation frameworks or LLMOps. Experience with NLP and production applications based on Large Language Models. Experience taking AI prototypes through to secure, scalable and production-grade applications. Experience with AI governance, risk or assurance frameworks, such as the EU AI Act, ISO/IEC 42001 or NIST AI RMF. Experience working in Financial Services or Energy. title: Global HR Operational Analyst
description: HR Operational Analyst Location: Bangalore Support Capco’s global contingent workforce through accurate, efficient and people-focused HR operations. The Role As an HR Operational Analyst at Capco, you’ll play an important role in supporting our global contingent worker process , helping to deliver a consistent and efficient experience across the contingent worker lifecycle. Based in Bangalore and reporting to the US-based Global HR Operations Manager , you’ll be part of a global HR Operations function, working with HR colleagues and stakeholders across Capco’s locations. You’ll coordinate contingent worker processes, maintain accurate records, support Purchase Order (PO) creation , respond to operational queries and help meet audit requirements . What You’ll Do Support the end-to-end operational processes for contingent workers globally , helping ensure onboarding, worker changes and offboarding activities are coordinated accurately and on time. Coordinate and support Purchase Order (PO) creation and related operational activities , working with relevant stakeholders to ensure information is complete, accurate and processed in line with established procedures. Maintain accurate contingent worker data, records and documentation, completing appropriate checks and providing information and evidence to support internal and external audit requirements . Respond to operational queries and collaborate with HR colleagues and global stakeholders to resolve issues, maintain consistent processes and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. Experience with PO creation or purchase-to-pay processes and working with Finance, Procurement or other supporting teams. Experience supporting HR operations, contingent workforce processes, HR shared services or a comparable operational environment . Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with experience maintaining accurate records and working with operational processes and data. Clear communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues across different teams, locations and time zones . Exposure to global HR Operations, shared services, audit activities or operational controls across multiple countries. title: Google Partnership & Alliances Sales Specialist
description: Location: London (Hybrid) |  Practice Area:  Ecosystems & Partnerships Type: Permanent Build strategic partnerships, unlock new opportunities, and accelerate growth through the Google Cloud ecosystem. The Role At Capco, we're looking for a Google Partnership & Alliances Sales Specialist to help develop and grow our strategic relationship with Google Cloud, creating new commercial opportunities and strengthening our position within the financial services industry. You'll play a key role in shaping and executing our Google Cloud alliance strategy, working closely with Google partner teams, Capco sales leaders, technology specialists, and client-facing teams to develop joint propositions, generate pipeline, and accelerate business growth. This is an opportunity to combine your partnership expertise, commercial awareness, and knowledge of the cloud technology ecosystem to help financial services clients unlock the value of cloud transformation. You'll be instrumental in connecting the right people, capabilities, and opportunities to build a successful, commercially focused partnership that delivers measurable results for Capco, Google Cloud, and our clients. What You’ll Do Drive Strategic Partnership Growth: Develop and strengthen Capco's relationship with Google Cloud, building productive connections with partner managers, account executives, industry specialists, and alliance stakeholders to identify new business opportunities. Accelerate Sales & Pipeline Development: Identify, qualify, and progress joint sales opportunities, working with Capco sales teams and Google Cloud to build a sustainable pipeline and support revenue growth across financial services clients. Shape Joint Go-to-Market Strategies: Work with Capco business and domain leads. Support internal Google Cloud stakeholders to develop compelling joint propositions, industry-specific solutions, campaigns, and go-to-market initiatives aligned with client priorities. Enable Partner-Led Sales Success: Coordinate account planning, opportunity mapping, sales enablement, partner engagement, and co-selling activities, ensuring effective collaboration between Capco and Google Cloud teams. Measure & Optimise Alliance Performance: Track partnership performance, pipeline development, joint opportunities, and commercial outcomes, identifying opportunities to improve engagement, strengthen execution, and maximise partnership value. What We’re Looking For Partnership & Alliances Experience: Demonstrable experience in setting up/ growing a partnership leading to sustained pipeline growth ideally with Google Cloud,  leveraging partner ecosystem to create multi-party sales plays,  internal stakeholder enablement and management,  Commercial & Sales Expertise: Experience creating industry focused sales plays preferably on Financial Services, developing GTM strategies and co-sell opportunities, building commercial pipelines, supporting complex sales cycles, and contributing to revenue growth through partners within enterprise technology or consulting environments. Google Cloud Ecosystem Knowledge: Understanding of Google Cloud's partner ecosystem, industry solution and regional/global sales play priorities, go-to-market approaches, top selling cloud services, commercial models, with the ability to connect technology capabilities to business outcomes. Stakeholder Engagement & Relationship Management: Ability to establish trusted relationships with partner ecosystems, sales leaders, delivery teams, and senior partner/client stakeholders, communicating effectively across different business functions. Financial Services & Consulting Awareness: Understanding of the financial services industry and the role of cloud and AI technologies in supporting business transformation in regulated industries, driving operational efficiency, and delivering digital innovation. Bonus Points For Experience managing or developing a strategic alliance with Google Cloud, including partner programmes, co-selling motions, and joint account planning. Existing professional relationships within the Google Cloud partner ecosystem, particularly across financial services and enterprise accounts. Familiarity with Google Cloud partner incentives, funding programmes, marketplace opportunities, and partner performance frameworks. Experience developing cloud transformation propositions across banking, capital markets, insurance, or other financial services sectors. Knowledge of cloud migration, data platforms, application modernisation, or other Google Cloud-enabled transformation services. Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications. Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services. Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy. Benefits We offer a competitive, people-first benefits package designed to support every aspect of your life. Next Steps: Applications for this role will close by the 25th of October. CV reviews will take place Monday 26th of October with successful candidates contacted by Tuesday 27th of October.
