title: Knowledge Graph & Ontologies Specialist
description: ABOUT CAPCO Capco, a Wipro company, is a global management and technology consultancy specialising in driving digital transformation across the financial services industry. Operating at the intersection of business and technology, Capco combines innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to fast-track initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, and insurance. Our ingenuity is brought to life through our Innovation Labs, award-winning Be Yourself at Work culture, and a diverse, talented team across more than 30 offices worldwide. ROLE DESCRIPTION As a Knowledge Graph & Ontologies Specialist, you will lead the design and delivery of enterprise knowledge graph and semantic ontology solutions for Capco's financial services clients across Asia. Based in Singapore, you will serve as a senior practitioner and trusted advisor to insurers, wealth managers, private banks, and capital markets firms — helping them realise the value of connected, semantically rich data. This is a hands-on, client-facing role. We are looking for someone who has built and deployed real-world knowledge graph solutions — ideally through experience at or with a graph technology vendor such as Stardog, Neo4j, Franz Inc. (AllegroGraph) or Ontotext (GraphDB), or through deep project delivery at a specialist consultancy.  You will join a growing data and AI practice in Asia and will have the opportunity to shape Capco's knowledge graph capability, contribute to thought leadership, and build lasting client relationships at the most senior levels. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES Lead the design, development, and delivery of enterprise knowledge graph architectures and domain ontologies for financial services clients. Define and govern ontological models representing complex financial data domains including insurance products, policy hierarchies, client entities, wealth portfolios, regulatory obligations, and counterparty relationships. Advise clients on the selection, configuration, and deployment of graph database and semantic technology platforms, including Stardog, Neo4j, AllegroGraph, GraphDB, and related tooling. Translate complex business requirements into formal ontological schemas, RDF/OWL models, and property graph structures appropriate to the use case. Collaborate with data architecture, AI/ML, and business intelligence teams to integrate knowledge graphs into broader enterprise data ecosystems, including data lakes, lakehouses, and AI pipelines. Conduct ontology reviews, maturity assessments, and gap analyses, providing clients with actionable roadmaps for knowledge graph adoption. Lead or support FIBO (Financial Industry Business Ontology) alignment, taxonomy development, and data governance initiatives. Drive the integration of knowledge graphs with large language model (LLM) and GenAI capabilities, including retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) architectures. Support business development activities including proposals, RFP responses, client workshops, and thought leadership publications. Mentor junior team members and play an active role in building Capco's knowledge graph practice and internal intellectual property across Asia. KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES Deliver high-quality knowledge graph and ontology solutions on time, within scope, and to client expectations. Ensure graph architectures align with enterprise data governance frameworks, regulatory requirements, and security standards relevant to financial services in Singapore and Hong Kong. Maintain and grow senior client relationships, acting as a trusted long-term advisor. Uphold Capco's standards of quality, integrity, and professionalism in all client engagements. Contribute measurably to Capco Asia's knowledge graph capability, including the development of reusable assets, accelerators, and methodologies. Be comfortable advising C-suite executives, Chief Data Officers, and senior technology leaders within major financial institutions. Demonstrate a practitioner mindset: able to architect, build, and validate solutions, not just advise on them. Have deep familiarity with insurance and/or wealth management data domains, with secondary exposure to banking or capital markets. AllegroGraph, Ontotext GraphDB, or equivalent production-grade graph engines. Deep knowledge of semantic web and linked data standards: OWL, RDF, RDFS, SPARQL, SHACL, SKOS, and JSON-LD. title: Liquidity Reporting- data analyst
description: Job title: Liquidity reporting Compliance   Finance has mobilised a multi-year Integrity of Regulatory Reporting (IRR) programme to ensure that Regulatory Reporting across the Group is fit for purpose; accurate, timely and complete. The IRR programme is responsible for overseeing the design and implementation of a set of standards and control outcomes that will be consistently applied across the end-to-end Regulatory Reporting Process. IRR will drive the interconnectivity across various strategic transformation programs to ensure linkages and dependencies are well understood and aligned to the IRR standards and control outcomes. The Liquidity Product Based Review (LIQ_PBR) workstream is part of the overall data controls framework for Liquidity Regulatory Reporting. Product Based Reviews enable Finance to develop key assurance that the end to end data flow for Business Data Elements (“BDE’s”), from upstream Primary Booking Systems to downstream Reporting data warehouses (including the Liquidity Reporting Finance Data Application / Platform) complies with the applicable group data standards and controls (‘DMOV’ and ‘DUSE’), is complete and valid for the production of key Liquidity reports and metrics and that data quality or completeness issues discovered through the PBR process are appropriately logged, reported, escalated and managed to resolution. title: Principal Consultant, Cybersecurity
description: About the Team Joining Capco means joining an organization that is committed to an inclusive working environment where you are encouraged to #BeYourselfAtWork. Capco's Cybersecurity Practice is a multi-disciplinary team focused on helping leading financial institutions navigate an increasingly complex cyber, technology, and regulatory landscape. We partner with clients to evaluate, design, and implement risk-aware solutions that strengthen resilience, protect critical assets, and enable innovation. As artificial intelligence continues to transform financial services, our team works closely with clients to develop secure and responsible AI adoption strategies, establish governance frameworks, manage emerging technology risks, and build trust in AI-enabled products and services. We combine deep expertise in cybersecurity, risk management, financial services, cloud transformation, and data protection to help executive leadership address their most critical business and security challenges. About the Job As a Principal Consultant within our Cyber Advisory Practice, you will serve as a trusted advisor to senior client stakeholders, leading complex cybersecurity and technology risk engagements across the Financial Services sector. You will be responsible for helping clients define and execute cybersecurity strategies, strengthen governance programs, manage enterprise risk, and address emerging challenges related to digital transformation, cloud adoption, and artificial intelligence. You will lead consulting teams, oversee delivery across multiple workstreams, contribute to business development initiatives, and play a key role in shaping the continued growth of Capco's Cybersecurity Practice. What You'll Get to Do Lead cybersecurity, technology risk, and AI governance engagements for global financial institutions, helping clients identify, assess, and mitigate cyber and emerging technology risks. Perform assessments of platforms, applications, cloud environments, AI-enabled solutions, and third-party services to identify risks related to data protection, model security, unauthorized access, regulatory compliance, and operational resilience. Design and implement cybersecurity strategies, governance frameworks, policies, standards, and controls that align business objectives with security, privacy, and regulatory requirements. Lead client workshops, executive presentations, and strategic advisory engagements while managing consulting teams and project delivery across multiple initiatives. Develop thought leadership, reference architectures, security automation capabilities, AI risk management frameworks, white papers, and market-facing intellectual property that enhances Capco's cybersecurity and AI advisory offerings. What You'll Bring with You 7+ years of experience in cybersecurity, technology risk, information security, or cyber advisory roles. Experience working within a management consulting or technology consulting environment. Deep knowledge of industry frameworks and standards, including NIST, ISO 27001, FFIEC, CIS, and other relevant regulatory and cybersecurity frameworks. Experience across multiple cybersecurity domains, including Operational Resilience, Data Security, Identity & Access Management, Cloud Security, Digital Trust, Threat & Vulnerability Management, Security Governance, or Cyber Risk Management. Knowledge of AI and GenAI governance, AI risk management, model security, responsible AI principles, and emerging regulatory considerations associated with AI adoption. Proven experience conducting cyber risk assessments, control evaluations, maturity assessments, and strategic cybersecurity transformation initiatives. Ability to communicate complex cybersecurity, technology, and AI-related risks to both technical and non-technical audiences, including executive leadership. Understanding of security engineering principles and secure development practices across the system development lifecycle. Experience leading projects independently, managing client relationships, developing proposals, and designing cybersecurity solutions. Strong storytelling, presentation, and communication skills with advanced proficiency in PowerPoint and Excel. Bachelor's or Master's degree in Cybersecurity, Information Security, Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field. Why Capco? A career at Capco is an opportunity to help reshape the competitive landscape in financial services. We launch new banks, transform existing institutions, and help our clients navigate complex business, technology, and regulatory change. As the world's largest financial services-focused consultancy, we partner with global banks, insurers, asset managers, and fintechs across strategy, digital transformation, cybersecurity, cloud, data, analytics, engineering, and emerging technologies. Our Cybersecurity Practice is at the forefront of helping clients secure the future of financial services. From cyber strategy and resilience to AI governance and responsible innovation, we help organizations balance growth, trust, and security in an increasingly digital world. Capco maintains an entrepreneurial culture with minimal bureaucracy, enabling our people to make an immediate impact. We offer opportunities to work directly with senior leaders, solve complex industry challenges, contribute to innovative client solutions, and accelerate your career through continuous learning and professional development. We offer highly competitive benefits, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan, tuition reimbursement, wellness programs, and a culture focused on innovation, collaboration, and delivering lasting value for our clients and employees. Ready to Take the Next Step? If you're passionate about cybersecurity, technology risk, and helping organizations navigate the opportunities and challenges of AI-driven transformation, we'd love to hear from you. Join Capco and help shape the future of secure, resilient, and responsible innovation across the financial services industry.   US Pay Range $154,000 — $192,000 USD

title: Principal Consultant - Data
description: Capco, a Wipro company, is a global technology and management consultancy specializing in driving digital transformation in the financial services industry. With a growing client portfolio comprising of over 100 global organizations, Capco operates at the intersection of business and technology by combining innovative thinking with unrivalled industry knowledge to deliver end-to-end data-driven solutions and fast-track digital initiatives for banking and payments, capital markets, wealth and asset management, insurance, and the energy sector. Capco’s cutting-edge ingenuity is brought to life through its Innovation Labs and award-winning Be Yourself At Work culture and diverse talent. We are experts in Banking, Capital Markets, and Wealth and Asset Management. We are rapidly expanding our Insurance sector capability. We specialise in Digital Transformation, Data Management & Data Analytics, Business & Finance Transformation engagements, and IT Transformation and Change programmes. We are committed to growing our business and hiring the best talent in the market. Our focus is on maintaining our agile and entrepreneurial culture. About the Job Capco’s Data Team helps our clients transform every aspect of their business. We are highly skilled at formulating data strategy, defining business and technology initiatives across the data management lifecycle and aligning multi-year strategic roadmaps with clients’ business goals. As digital technologies advance and regulations tighten, today’s consumers and today’s businesses are becoming more aware of the importance of good quality data. We work to establish holistic ways to effectively manage data through the modern data supply chain and facilitate consumption through analytics, modelling, AI, machine learning, dashboarding, and reporting. What You'll Get to Do Design, implement, and enhance enterprise Data Governance and Data Management Frameworks across banking and financial services clients. Develop and maintain data governance artifacts including data dictionaries, business glossaries, metadata catalogues, data lineage, critical data elements, and data classification standards . Support enterprise Data Architecture, Data Quality, Master Data Management (MDM), and Metadata Management initiatives. Drive Data Sovereignty, Data Residency, and Regulatory Compliance programs aligned with banking and financial services requirements. Partner with business, technology, risk, compliance, and executive stakeholders to embed governance across the data lifecycle. Deliver data transformation initiatives using Agile methodologies and support executive-level reporting and governance forums. Leverage governance tools such as Collibra, Informatica, Microsoft Purview, Ab Initio, or similar platforms to improve data transparency, control, and quality. What You'll Bring With You Bachelor's degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Data Analytics, Finance, Mathematics, Operations Research, or a related discipline. 10+ years' proven experience delivering Data Governance, Data Management, Data Architecture, Data Quality, or Enterprise Data Transformation programs. Strong financial services experience across Banking, Wealth Management, Insurance, or Capital Markets . Knowledge of industry frameworks such as DCAM , Data Governance Operating Models, Control Frameworks, and Data Lifecycle Management. Experience with Data Lineage, Metadata Management, Master Data Management, Data Quality, and Data Architecture . Strong stakeholder management skills with the ability to engage senior executives, regulators, and cross-functional teams. Hands-on experience with Collibra (preferred) or other enterprise data governance and metadata management tools. Experience delivering projects using Agile or hybrid methodologies. Fluent English communication skills; Arabic language skills advantageous for regional engagements. Nice to Have Experience delivering data governance programs aligned to BCBS 239, CCAR, GDPR, PIPL, MAS TRM , or related financial services regulations. Knowledge of Data Sovereignty, Cross-Border Data Management, and Data Privacy frameworks . Experience with cloud-based data transformation and enterprise data platforms. Relevant certifications such as DCAM, CDMP, DAMA, AWS, Azure, or GCP . Proven programme delivery and change management experience, including large-scale data transformation initiatives. Eligibility to Work in Singapore Applicants must have unrestricted working rights in Singapore. Only Singapore Citizens and Singapore Permanent Residents (PRs) will be considered. Employment Pass sponsorship is not available for this role.   WHY CAPCO?   We are expanding our business rapidly across Singapore and Asia. You will work on engaging projects with some of the largest banking and insurance clients in the world, projects that will deliver significant transformation and change. We offer: You will join a company that supports and encourages an entrepreneurial outlook and independent thinking. Capco is not about organizational charts and layers – we operate with little hierarchy because we want all employees to feel that Capco is their firm. We warmly value diversity and inclusion and embrace our collective uniqueness – our culture is a strong, fresh, and invigorating difference from our competitors. We offer highly competitive benefits, including medical and dental insurance and a work culture focused on innovation and creation of lasting value for our clients and employees.

title: Principal Consultant - Data Scientist Lead
description: Data Scientist Lead Location: Hong Kong (Hybrid) | Practice Area : Data & Analytics | Type: Permanent The Role As a Data Scientist Lead at Capco, you’ll help clients optimise fraud models, machine learning platforms and supporting Google Cloud infrastructure, turning detailed analysis into practical, implementation-ready recommendations. You’ll take a hands-on approach to improving model and platform performance, reliability and run-cost across GCP infrastructure and ML pipelines. Working closely with IT infrastructure teams, data scientists and fraud stakeholders, you’ll identify opportunities to reduce compute and inference costs while maintaining effective, resilient solutions. You’ll provide configuration-level and code-level guidance, supported by clear estimates of implementation effort, expected savings and measurable outcomes. You’ll also use approved AI tools and AI-enabled workflows where appropriate to accelerate analysis, improve insight and support delivery, while maintaining human judgement, appropriate review and responsible AI guardrails. What You’ll Do GCP engineering: Lead hands-on design, diagnostics and optimisation across compute, storage and network services, implementing monitoring and observability to improve cost, performance and reliability. Fraud ML modelling: Support the development, validation and deployment of fraud and ML models end-to-end, identifying measurable opportunities to reduce compute requirements, accelerate inference and improve automation. ML and data pipelines: Optimise pipelines spanning ingest, transformation, feature creation and serving, training and inference, with a focus on cost efficiency, performance, resilience and responsible AI-enabled automation where appropriate. Big data and distributed processing: Develop and tune large-scale batch and streaming workloads using Spark or similar technologies, improving efficiency, stability and production readiness. Engineering excellence: Apply strong Python and SQL skills alongside CI/CD, automated testing, modular design and disciplined code review, using approved AI tools where appropriate to improve engineering productivity while ensuring outputs remain subject to human review and established controls. What We’re Looking For Strong hands-on experience in data science, machine learning engineering or ML platform optimisation, including the ability to translate analysis into practical, implementation-ready recommendations. Deep experience with Google Cloud Platform and the optimisation of cloud compute, storage, networking and ML workloads for performance, reliability and cost. Strong Python and SQL skills, together with experience building, validating, deploying and optimising production ML models and data pipelines. Experience with large-scale distributed data processing technologies such as Spark and applying sound software engineering practices including CI/CD, automated testing and code review. An ability to collaborate effectively with infrastructure, data science and business stakeholders, with curiosity about approved AI tools and the judgement to apply AI-enabled workflows responsibly, including appropriate guardrails, review, escalation and auditability. Bonus Points For Experience supporting fraud detection, financial crime or other high-volume decisioning models within financial services. Exposure to or implementation experience with Feedzai, including integration, performance tuning or operationalisation. Experience demonstrating measurable cloud or ML cost savings, including reduced compute consumption, faster inference or improved automation. Familiarity with production monitoring, model/platform observability and performance optimisation across complex ML environments. Experience applying AI, including Generative AI or Agentic AI where appropriate, to engineering or data workflows within controlled and regulated environments. Experience engaging effectively with engineers and architects, understanding technical designs and dependencies, and translating them into program and business implications for technical and non-technical stakeholders. Proven experience delivering data modernization, data platforms, data governance, analytics, cloud, or similar transformation initiatives, supported by strong program management capabilities across planning, dependencies, RAID management, governance, and executive reporting. We celebrate individuality and recognize that diversity and inclusion, in all forms, is critical to success. It’s important to us that we recruit and develop as diverse a range of talent as we can and we believe that everyone brings something different to the table – so we’d love to know what makes you different. Successful candidates will be involved in advising on financial crime risk management and delivering transformation across AML/KYC, Transaction Monitoring, Sanctions and Fraud. The role will entail working across all types of financial institutions in the market to help them navigate and deliver against key regulatory requirements and business objectives.  This would range across: Supporting our clients to achieve compliance with regulatory obligations, including dealing with remediation and response to regulatory reviews. Transforming and automating financial crime, sanctions and fraud operating models and processes through the implementation of new technologies (e.g. AI) that can bring a holistic and faster approach to identifying and managing financial crime, sanctions and fraud risk, whilst delivering cost optimisation for our clients. Analysing our clients’ capabilities and finding opportunities to save costs and improve risk management through innovation within existing anti-financial crime and anti-fraud functions Assessing, benchmarking, and re-designing financial crime and fraud target operating models and controls, identifying weaknesses and proposing improvements. Supporting clients in dealing with operational backlogs (e.g. KYC files and alerts). Sourcing and implementing technology solutions for KYC, TM, Sanctions and Fraud. Skills & Expertise A good understanding of the wider picture of financial crime, sanctions and fraud including regulatory requirements, risk assessment, KYC and how all components interrelate and support each other across the three lines of defence. Experience of delivering automation and transformation using AI Financial crime tooling and processes (across risk assessment, screening, transaction monitoring, KYC/CDD), Fraud (detection, prevention, response) Sanctions regimes, including tooling and processes This will be coupled with strong change management experience (preferably Agile certifications) and prior success, either as a management consultant or within a change role in a financial services institution.  This role allows you to deliver as part of a long-term strategic partnership with our clients, whilst developing within a forward thinking and entrepreneurial business.   An understanding of the key market, global and regulatory drivers shaping the financial crime and the wider industry and an ability to articulate these by way of opportunities for consulting firms to support the industry. Proven expertise delivering change and lead transformation programmes Self-starter and strong team player. Strong interpersonal & written communication skills. Strong problem-solving skills and an analytical mind-set. Demonstrable expertise in building and leveraging relationships. To be able to face off to key stakeholders with strong credibility. The ability to present to a wide range of stakeholder from AVP to senior MDs.   Other Expectations To balance client delivery with supporting development of new client opportunities or market propositions and proactive sales efforts within Financial Crime team. For senior level candidates Mentor and coach other members of the team. Solution development, showing a clear ability as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) to enhance existing propositions, and develop new ones. People management, building a team of consultants with the right mix of grades, skills and experience to support client opportunities and projected growth. This role is designed for a versatile technical leader who can move across knowledge-graph engineering, AI solution development, data modeling, and data-pipeline delivery. Familiarity with cloud and modern data platforms such as Microsoft Azure, AWS, Google Cloud, Microsoft Fabric, Databricks, Snowflake, BigQuery, or Redshift. Understanding of relational, graph, document, vector, and lakehouse architectures and when to use each. Experience with Git, CI/CD, automated testing, containers, Agile delivery, and production-support practices. Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to business stakeholders, architects, engineers, data scientists, and executives. Demonstrated ability to operate across multiple roles, learn new technologies quickly, and take ownership from initial discovery through production delivery. title: Senior Consultant, Cryptography

The Role As a Senior Consultant, Cryptography at Capco, you will help our financial services clients strengthen how they protect sensitive data across on-premises and cloud environments. You will bring practical knowledge of applied cryptography alongside experience identifying cryptographic and data security gaps at enterprise scale. Working with technology teams, asset owners and other stakeholders, you will help develop cryptographic requirements, monitor adherence, identify areas of non-compliance and support effective remediation. The role spans cryptographic governance, encryption, PKI, key lifecycle management and emerging areas such as post-quantum cryptography and cryptographic agility. What You’ll Do Develop and enhance cryptography frameworks, guiding principles, policies, procedures, standards and technical requirements. Identify cryptographic and data security gaps, assess their impact and work with asset owners and stakeholders to remediate areas of non-compliance. Support cryptographic protection of Data at Rest and Data in Transit across on-premises and public cloud environments. Provide guidance across encryption, PKI, key lifecycle management, TLS, digital certificates and database Transparent Data Encryption (TDE). Develop and execute remediation plans relating to audit findings and help strengthen cryptographic controls across complex enterprise environments. What We’re Looking For Strong experience with applied cryptography, cryptographic governance and enterprise data protection within complex technology environments. Knowledge of symmetric and asymmetric encryption, PKI, x509 digital certificates, SSH, TLS, TLS cipher suites and cryptographic key lifecycle management. Experience with encryption technologies across databases and cloud environments, including TDE and protection of sensitive data in public cloud. Ability to perform impact and stakeholder analysis, identify security gaps and translate technical findings into clear, practical remediation activities. Strong documentation, communication and presentation skills, with the ability to work effectively with technical teams, asset owners and other stakeholders. Knowledge of database encryption across technologies such as MS SQL, Oracle, DB2 or MongoDB. Experience supporting audit findings, control assessments or remediation programmes within financial services. Knowledge of post-quantum cryptography and the implications of emerging cryptographic standards. Understanding of cryptographic agility and approaches for preparing enterprise environments for changes in cryptographic algorithms and standards. title: Senior Consultant* / Manager* – ServiceNow Specialist (GRC / IRM)
description: Standort : Frankfurt am Main, Düsseldorf, Berlin, München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Anstellungsart : Unbefristet Gestalte die Zukunft des Risiko- und Compliance-Managements – mit ServiceNow, intelligenten Workflows und innovativen Technologien. Die Rolle   Als Senior Consultant* / Manager* – ServiceNow Specialist (GRC / IRM) bei Capco unterstützt du führende Banken, Asset Manager und Versicherungen bei der Konzeption, Transformation und Implementierung moderner Risiko- und Compliance-Prozesse auf Basis der ServiceNow-Plattform. Du berätst unsere Kunden an der Schnittstelle zwischen Fachbereich und Technologie und entwickelst gemeinsam mit Verantwortlichen aus Risikomanagement, Compliance und IT zukunftsfähige Prozess- und Systemlandschaften. Dabei analysierst du bestehende Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Strukturen, konzipierst skalierbare Zielarchitekturen und begleitest deren fachliche und technische Umsetzung. Du nutzt moderne Automatisierungsansätze und freigegebene KI-Technologien, um Prozesse effizienter zu gestalten, fundierte Entscheidungen zu unterstützen und die Qualität von Risiko- und Compliance-Lösungen kontinuierlich zu verbessern. Dabei berücksichtigst du regulatorische Anforderungen, nachvollziehbare Kontrollmechanismen und die notwendige menschliche Überprüfung KI-gestützter Ergebnisse. In interdisziplinären Projektteams übernimmst du Verantwortung für anspruchsvolle Transformationsvorhaben und gestaltest die Weiterentwicklung unserer ServiceNow-GRC-/IRM-Kompetenzen aktiv mit. Deine Aufgaben   Du analysierst bestehende Governance-, Risk- und Compliance-Prozesse und entwickelst maßgeschneiderte ServiceNow-GRC-/IRM-Lösungen für Banken, Versicherungen und Asset Manager – von der strategischen Zielsetzung bis zur erfolgreichen Implementierung. Du konzipierst skalierbare Workflows, Datenmodelle und Steuerungsmechanismen für Operational Risk, IT Risk, Third-Party Risk Management, Compliance, Internal Controls und Audit. Dabei identifizierst du Potenziale für KI-gestützte Automatisierung und intelligente Prozessoptimierung. Du führst Workshops und Prozessanalysen durch, bewertest die Eignung bestehender Prozesse für ServiceNow und entwickelst fundierte Zielbilder, Business Cases sowie Kosten-Nutzen-Bewertungen. Du übersetzt fachliche und regulatorische Anforderungen in technische Lösungskonzepte und arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Projektleitungen, Architekten und Entwicklungsteams zusammen. Du setzt freigegebene KI-Tools zur Unterstützung von Analyse, Dokumentation und Qualitätssicherung ein und stellst die fachliche Validierung der Ergebnisse sicher. Du unterstützt Transformationsprogramme, gestaltest Kundenpräsentationen und Angebotsprozesse mit und förderst den Wissensaustausch innerhalb unserer ServiceNow-Community. Auf Manager-Level übernimmst du zusätzlich Verantwortung für fachliche Themen, Kundenbeziehungen und die Weiterentwicklung von Teammitgliedern. Dein Profil   Du bringst mehrjährige praktische Erfahrung in der Einführung, Konfiguration oder Weiterentwicklung von ServiceNow-Lösungen mit Schwerpunkt Governance, Risk & Compliance (GRC) beziehungsweise Integrated Risk Management (IRM) mit. Du verfügst über fundierte Kenntnisse in Risk Management, IT Risk, Compliance oder Non-Financial Risk und verstehst die Anforderungen regulierter Finanzinstitute sowie die Zusammenhänge zwischen Geschäftsprozessen, Kontrollen und IT-Systemen. Du hast ServiceNow-Projekte von der Analyse über die Konzeption bis zur Umsetzung begleitet und kannst komplexe fachliche Anforderungen in skalierbare digitale Workflows und technische Lösungsansätze übersetzen. Du bist offen für den verantwortungsvollen Einsatz KI-gestützter Arbeitsweisen und Automatisierung zur Verbesserung von Effizienz und Qualität. Du arbeitest sicher mit Stakeholdern aus Fachbereichen, Risikomanagement, Compliance, Informationssicherheit und IT zusammen. Du moderierst Workshops, führst Interviews und präsentierst Ergebnisse adressatengerecht. Sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse runden dein Profil ab. Du verfügst über ein abgeschlossenes Hochschulstudium, beispielsweise in Wirtschaftswissenschaften, Wirtschaftsinformatik oder Informatik, oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation. Du arbeitest strukturiert, lösungsorientiert und übernimmst Verantwortung für deine Themen und Projektergebnisse. Nice to have   ServiceNow-Zertifizierungen: Du besitzt Zertifizierungen wie Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS) für IRM/GRC oder vergleichbare Qualifikationen. Regulatorisches Know-how: Du kennst relevante regulatorische Anforderungen und Standards wie DORA, MaRisk, BAIT, VAIT, EBA Guidelines oder internationale Governance- und Risikomanagement-Frameworks. GRC-Plattformkenntnisse: Du hast Erfahrung mit weiteren GRC-Lösungen wie RSA Archer oder MetricStream und idealerweise bereits Plattformmigrationen oder Transformationsprojekte in Richtung ServiceNow begleitet. KI und intelligente Automatisierung: Du bringst Kenntnisse in KI, einschließlich Generative AI, Workflow Intelligence oder Process Mining, mit und verstehst deren Einsatzmöglichkeiten innerhalb von ServiceNow. Idealerweise kennst du Prinzipien verantwortungsvoller KI-Nutzung, einschließlich menschlicher Freigaben, Kontrollmechanismen und nachvollziehbarer Ergebnisse. Transformation und Business Development: Du hast in komplexen Transformationsprogrammen im Finanzdienstleistungssektor gearbeitet, bringst Erfahrung in Presales-, Angebots- oder RFP-Prozessen mit und unterstützt gerne die fachliche Weiterentwicklung anderer Teammitglieder.   Warum Capco?     Arbeite an wirkungsvollen Transformations- und Regulierungsprojekten für führende Finanzinstitute. Werde Teil einer kollaborativen, flachen und unternehmerisch geprägten Beratungskultur. Nutze kontinuierliche Lern-, Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten. Arbeite mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen an der Schnittstelle von Financial Services, Regulatorik, Risiko und Technologie. Gestalte die Zukunft von Digital Operational Resilience und regulatorischer Transformation aktiv mit.   Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges, auf unsere Mitarbeitenden ausgerichtetes Benefits-Paket, das Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung unterstützt. Benefits Flexible Arbeitsmodelle und hybrides Arbeiten je nach Projekteinsatz möglich. Ein umfassendes Onboarding sowie Dein persönlicher Coach und Buddy; kontinuierliches Feedback und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, unter anderem über interne Trainings und Udemy Business. Bike-Leasing-Programme sowie eine Capco Benefits Card mit monatlicher Gutschrift in Höhe von 44 EUR. Regelmäßige Gesundheitschecks, Mental-Health-Kurse und Unterstützung durch den PME-Familienservice für unterschiedliche Lebenssituationen. Unbefristeter Arbeitsvertrag, großartige Firmenevents und After-Work-Veranstaltungen sowie ein dynamisches und internationales Umfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und vielfältigen Möglichkeiten, Deine Talente einzubringen.   Inklusion bei Capco Wir setzen uns für einen barrierefreien und inklusiven Recruiting-Prozess ein. Solltest Du in einer Phase des Bewerbungsprozesses Unterstützung oder Anpassungen benötigen, sprich uns gerne an – wir helfen Dir weiter. Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Perspektiven. Bei Capco schätzen wir die individuellen Beiträge jedes Einzelnen. Unsere #BeYourselfAtWork-Kultur steht für Vielfalt, Chancengerechtigkeit und Inklusion und prägt die Zusammenarbeit mit unseren Kunden sowie untereinander.   *Wichtig ist nur, dass wir zueinander passen (m/w/d) #beyourselfatwork.

title: (Senior) Consultant* – Operational & Cyber Resilience
description: Location: Frankfurt, Düsseldorf, Berlin, München (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Finance, Risk, Regulatory & Financial Crime | Type: Permanent   Gestalte mit uns die digitale und operationale Resilienz von Finanzinstituten – von DORA und IKT-Risikomanagement bis hin zu Third Party Risk und Operational Resilience.   Die Rolle   Als (Senior) Consultant* – Operational & Cyber Resilience unterstützt Du unsere Kundinnen und Kunden aus der Finanzindustrie bei der Umsetzung regulatorischer Anforderungen, insbesondere rund um den Digital Operational Resilience Act (DORA) und den einschlägigen EBA Guidelines. Du arbeitest an der Schnittstelle von Regulatorik, IKT-Risikomanagement, Operational Resilience und IT Governance und begleitest unsere Kunden von der Analyse bestehender Strukturen bis zur nachhaltigen Umsetzung.   Dabei beschäftigst Du Dich unter anderem mit IKT-Kontrollframeworks, Incident Management, Third Party Risk Management sowie Auslagerungsmanagement. Du nutzt zudem freigegebene AI-Tools, Automatisierung und AI-enabled Workflows dort, wo sie Analysen, Qualität und Produktivität sinnvoll verbessern – stets unter Berücksichtigung menschlicher Beurteilung, angemessener Kontrollen und Responsible-AI-Vorgaben.   Deine Aufgaben   Berate Finanzinstitute bei der Umsetzung und Weiterentwicklung von DORA-Anforderungen sowie beim Aufbau einer nachhaltigen Digital Operational Resilience.   Analysiere und optimiere IKT-/IT-Risikomanagement, IT Governance sowie IKT-/IT-Kontrollframeworks und unterstütze bei der Entwicklung geeigneter Governance- und Kontrollstrukturen.   Unterstütze bei Third Party Risk Management, ICT Third Party Risk, IT Supplier Risk und Auslagerungsmanagement – von Risikoanalysen bis zur Implementierung belastbarer Steuerungsprozesse.   Begleite unsere Kunden bei ICT Incident Management und Major ICT Incidents , einschließlich der Weiterentwicklung relevanter Prozesse, Kontrollen und regulatorischer Anforderungen.   Nutze freigegebene AI- und Automatisierungslösungen , um beispielsweise Analysen, Dokumentation und Kontrollaktivitäten effizienter zu gestalten, und stelle dabei Human-in-the-Loop-Prüfung, nachvollziehbare Ergebnisse und erforderliche Eskalationswege sicher.   Dein Profil   Erfahrung oder fundierte Kenntnisse im Bereich DORA, IKT-/IT-Risikomanagement, Operational Resilience oder Operational Risk , idealerweise im Finanzdienstleistungsumfeld.   Kenntnisse in mindestens einem weiteren relevanten Themenfeld wie IT Governance, ICT Controls, Incident Management, Third Party Risk Management oder Auslagerungsmanagement .   Fähigkeit, regulatorische Anforderungen zu analysieren, verständlich aufzubereiten und gemeinsam mit unterschiedlichen Stakeholdern in praktikable Governance-, Risiko- und Kontrollmaßnahmen zu übersetzen.   Erfahrung in der Rolle als (interner oder externer) Unternehmensberater mit einem Track Record an erfolgreichen Beiträgen zu Projekterfolgen.   Eine strukturierte und analytische Arbeitsweise sowie Freude daran, komplexe regulatorische und technologische Fragestellungen gemeinsam mit Kunden zu bearbeiten.   Neugier auf AI-enabled Ways of Working und die Bereitschaft, freigegebene AI-Tools verantwortungsvoll einzusetzen , einschließlich kritischer Prüfung der Ergebnisse sowie Beachtung relevanter Guardrails, Review- und Eskalationsprozesse.   Fließende Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse. Nice to have   Erfahrung mit der Konzeption oder Weiterentwicklung von IKT-/IT-Control Frameworks und entsprechenden Governance-Modellen.   Praktische Erfahrung mit DORA-Implementierungs- oder Transformationsprogrammen bei Banken, Versicherungen oder anderen Finanzinstituten.   Kenntnisse im Third Party Risk Management und Auslagerungsmanagement , insbesondere im Kontext regulatorischer Anforderungen an IKT-Drittdienstleister.   Erfahrung mit Major ICT Incident Management , Operational Resilience oder der Gestaltung entsprechender Risiko- und Kontrollprozesse.   Erfahrung darin, AI, GenAI oder Automatisierung verantwortungsvoll für Analyse-, Dokumentations- oder Kontrollprozesse einzusetzen.   Warum Capco?     Arbeite an wirkungsvollen Transformations- und Regulierungsprojekten für führende Finanzinstitute. Werde Teil einer kollaborativen, flachen und unternehmerisch geprägten Beratungskultur. Nutze kontinuierliche Lern-, Weiterbildungs- und Zertifizierungsmöglichkeiten. Arbeite mit erfahrenen Kolleginnen und Kollegen an der Schnittstelle von Financial Services, Regulatorik, Risiko und Technologie. Gestalte die Zukunft von Digital Operational Resilience und regulatorischer Transformation aktiv mit.   Wir bieten ein wettbewerbsfähiges, auf unsere Mitarbeitenden ausgerichtetes Benefits-Paket, das Deine berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung unterstützt. Ein umfassendes Onboarding sowie Dein persönlicher Coach und Buddy; kontinuierliches Feedback und Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten, unter anderem über interne Trainings und Udemy Business. title: Senior Consultant / Principal Consultant - Capital Markets
description: Role Overview We are seeking an experienced Capital Markets Consultant to support business transformation, regulatory change, and technology implementation initiatives across capital markets. The candidate will work closely with business stakeholders, front-, middle-, and back-office teams, technology teams, and external partners to deliver solutions that improve operational efficiency, strengthen risk management, and enhance trading and post-trade processes.  The ideal candidate is a capital markets professional with 6–8 years of experience who combines strong financial services domain knowledge with consulting, business analysis, and project delivery capabilities. The candidate should be comfortable engaging with stakeholders, analysing complex business processes, translating requirements into practical solutions, and driving deliverables across multidisciplinary teams. Key Responsibilities Capital Markets Domain Expertise Demonstrate strong understanding of capital markets products, processes, and operating models across equities, fixed income, foreign exchange, derivatives, and structured products. Understand the trade lifecycle, including trade execution, confirmation, clearing, settlement, collateral management, and reconciliations. Work across front-office, middle-office, and back-office functions, depending on project requirements. Understand market infrastructure, including exchanges, central counterparties (CCPs), central securities depositories (CSDs), and custodians. Support initiatives involving trading platforms, order management systems (OMS), execution management systems (EMS), and post-trade processing platforms. Business Analysis and Consulting Engage with business stakeholders to understand business needs, pain points, and operational challenges. Conduct workshops, stakeholder interviews, process assessments, and gap analyses. Translate business needs into business requirements documents (BRDs), functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Develop current-state and future-state process maps and recommend process improvements. Perform impact assessments for business, operational, regulatory, and technology changes. Support solution design and ensure alignment between business objectives and technical implementation. Project Delivery and Implementation Drive assigned workstreams across the project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to testing, implementation, and post-go-live support. Coordinate with business, technology, operations, risk, compliance, and vendor teams. Support Agile delivery practices, including sprint planning, backlog refinement, daily stand-ups, and sprint reviews, where applicable. Manage dependencies, risks, issues, and deliverables within the assigned workstream. Prepare project documentation, status reports, presentations, and stakeholder updates. Support change management, user training, and business readiness activities Regulatory and Risk Initiatives Support regulatory and market-driven transformation initiatives relevant to capital markets. Assess the impact of regulatory changes on trading, clearing, settlement, reporting, and risk management processes. Contribute to initiatives involving transaction reporting, trade transparency, market conduct, and regulatory compliance. Support implementation of relevant market standards and industry initiatives, such as Legal Entity Identifiers (LEIs), ISO 20022, and applicable settlement or reporting reforms. Work with risk and compliance stakeholders to identify control gaps and support remediation activities. description: Data Analytics – Senior Consultant Location: London (Hybrid) | Practice Area: Data & Analytics | Type: Permanent Unlock insights. Empower decisions. Define architecture principles, integration patterns, and technology standards. Design cloud-native, microservices-based, and event-driven architectures. Collaborate with engineering, DevOps, security, and business stakeholders to ensure successful solution delivery. Evaluate technology options, identify architectural trade-offs, and provide recommendations aligned with business objectives. Support cloud migration and modernization initiatives. Contribute to technical proposals, solution assessments, and pre-sales activities where needed. Act as a trusted technology advisor, combining hands-on technical expertise with a strong consulting mindset. What We're Looking For Must-have skills and experience: Proven experience as a Solution Architect, Cloud Architect, or in a similar architecture-focused role. Strong hands-on knowledge of Google Cloud Platform (GCP) and its core services. Experience designing distributed systems, cloud-native applications, and enterprise integration solutions. Solid understanding of microservices, APIs, event-driven architectures, and integration patterns. Experience with containerization and orchestration technologies, such as Docker and Kubernetes (GKE). Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD practices. Good understanding of cloud security, networking, scalability, reliability, and performance. Ability to communicate complex technical concepts to both technical and non-technical stakeholders. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills. Consulting mindset - proactive, client-oriented, pragmatic, and comfortable working in dynamic environments. Excellent English communication skills. Nice to have: Experience in financial services or banking is highly desirable , particularly in complex, regulated enterprise environments. Experience with banking platforms, payment systems, or financial services integrations. Knowledge of regulatory, security, and compliance requirements relevant to financial institutions. Experience with GCP services such as BigQuery, Pub/Sub, Cloud Run, Apigee, or Cloud Functions. Experience working in consulting or client-facing technology delivery roles. Google Cloud Professional Cloud Architect certification or equivalent. Why Join Capco? Work on challenging technology transformation projects for leading financial institutions. Join a collaborative, international consulting environment combining business and technology expertise. Influence architectural decisions and help shape modern cloud solutions. Collaborate with experienced architects, engineers, and business consultants. Enjoy a hybrid working model based in Warsaw . Develop your expertise through diverse projects, knowledge sharing, and professional growth opportunities. Who Will Thrive in This Role? We are looking for more than a technical architect. We value someone who can think like a consultant, communicate like a trusted advisor, and design like an engineer . If you enjoy solving complex business problems through technology, challenging assumptions, and turning architecture into real business value, we'd love to hear from you. >#LI-HYBRID

title: Techno-Functional SME Consultant (m/f/d)
description: Role Overview The Techno-Functional SME Consultant for Finastra Loan IQ is responsible for the stable operation, functional integrity and continuous improvement of the bank’s commercial-lending platform. The role combines deep lending-domain knowledge with hands-on application-support capability to ensure that loan transactions are configured, processed, serviced, accounted for and supported accurately throughout their lifecycle. Operating at the intersection of Loan Operations, Credit, Finance, Risk and IT, the consultant owns functional analysis and coordinates technical resolution across Loan IQ, interfaces and downstream systems. The role supports production operations, incidents, problems, changes, releases, controls and sustainable remediation of recurring service issues. Key Responsibilities Application operations: Manage Loan IQ application health, critical business events, interfaces, batch processes and operational queues. Ensure timely completion of daily processing and proactive management of service risks. Incident resolution: Lead functional and technical analysis of production incidents; reproduce issues, assess business impact, identify controlled workarounds, coordinate recovery and restore service within agreed priorities. Problem management: Perform root-cause analysis for recurring defects, transaction failures, schedule inconsistencies, accounting breaks and interface errors. Drive permanent fixes and preventive controls. Functional analysis: Translate lending-business issues into clear functional requirements, impact assessments, solution options, test scenarios and acceptance criteria. Technical troubleshooting: Analyse Loan IQ configuration, application logs, database evidence, interfaces, messages and job failures in collaboration with technical teams and within controlled production-support practices. Integration management: Support integrations with origination, payment, core banking, general ledger, data, risk, regulatory-reporting, document and notification platforms. Change and release support: Assess Loan IQ releases, patches, configuration changes and enhancements; coordinate functional validation, regression testing, deployment readiness, post-release verification and rollback planning. Vendor coordination: Engage Finastra and other vendors on product defects, patches and complex investigations. Provide reproducible evidence, track remediation and validate delivered fixes. Controls and documentation: Maintain operating procedures, functional knowledge, configuration records, interface inventories, support playbooks, known-error records and audit evidence. Distributed delivery: Work with offshore and distributed support teams, ensure effective handovers, maintain functional knowledge depth and drive consistent outcomes across locations and time zones. Required Experience and Expertise 8+ years of experience in commercial-lending technology or banking application support, with substantial hands-on expertise in Finastra Loan IQ. Strong knowledge of Loan IQ customer, deal, facility and outstanding structures, together with servicing, settlement and accounting processes. Demonstrated functional expertise in flexible loans, restructurings, end-to-end loan lifecycle events and loan-schedule management. Experience supporting production incidents, service requests, problems, changes and releases for a business-critical banking application. Experience with Loan IQ integrations and, where applicable, Loan IQ SDK-based extensions, reports or interfaces. Experience preparing functional specifications, impact assessments, test scenarios, regression packs, operating procedures and knowledge articles. Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, stakeholder-management and communication skills. Preferred Qualifications University degree in Finance, Banking, Business Administration, Information Technology, Computer Science or a related discipline. Finastra Loan IQ product training or implementation experience across servicing, settlement, accounting or integration workstreams. Knowledge of ITIL, Agile delivery, release management, testing and operational-risk controls. Experience in Loan IQ upgrades, platform modernization, data migration, interface development or operational transformation.

At least 4 years of practical experience with Temenos, ideally including Temenos Core / Transact lending, limits, collateral, or corporate lending capabilities, with participation in at least two implementation, upgrade, or major transformation programmes. Strong functional knowledge of the lending lifecycle, including product and facility setup, drawdown, servicing, pricing, repayment, limits, collateral, and exposure management, in retail, private-banking, commercial, or corporate environments. Proven ability to configure and troubleshoot Temenos lending products and parameters across facilities, limits, pricing, interest, schedules, fees, drawdowns, repayments, collateral linkages, covenants, and lifecycle events. Strong understanding of credit and exposure management, secured and unsecured lending, collateral concepts, interest and accrual calculations, repayment structures, loan amendments, and operational credit controls. Working knowledge of APIs, message and file interfaces, credit-origination and risk-system integration, accounting, payments, batch processing, and data migration or reconciliation; SQL or comparable data-analysis skills are an advantage. Demonstrated experience working in complex banking programmes with multiple lending, risk, operations, technology, vendor, and implementation-partner stakeholders. Structured problem-solving skills and the ability to translate complex credit and lending requirements into practical, testable, and maintainable Temenos configurations. Comfortable working in agile or hybrid delivery environments, taking ownership of deliverables from requirements and design through testing, release, and post-go-live stabilization. Professional fluency in English (C1 level or equivalent), including the ability to produce clear functional and technical documentation. A solid understanding of how banking IT and infrastructure organizations operate . In Short This role would be a perfect fit for someone with a technical delivery / project coordination background in banking who loves working across multiple technical teams, managing smaller initiatives, and getting things delivered efficiently. description: Due to our continued growth, Precision for Medicine is looking for a Senior Feasibility Associate/Feasibility Manager to join our European team. The final title, Senior Feasibility Associate or Feasibility Manager, will be determined based on the successful candidate’s experience and demonstrated level of responsibility. Position Summary: The Feasibility Manager is a member of Precision for Medicine’s expert Feasibility Department and is responsible for delivering evidence-based feasibility assessments across pre-award, post-award, rescue, and stand-alone engagements. The role combines clinical and scientific interpretation with operational intelligence and data analysis to develop country, site, patient-pool, and recruitment recommendations. The Feasibility Manager partners with Business Development, Clinical Operations, Medical, and other cross-functional stakeholders to ensure that recommendations are scientifically credible, operationally realistic, and clearly communicated. The successful candidate will manage assigned feasibility deliverables, present analyses and recommendations to internal stakeholders and clients, and contribute to strategic initiatives that strengthen Precision for Medicine’s feasibility capabilities and competitive position. Key responsibilities Lead or contribute to feasibility assessments for client requests for proposals. Review clinical protocols, study assumptions, client information, and operational plans for United States and global clinical trials. Conduct and synthesise competitive landscape, historical recruitment, standard-of-care, treatment landscape, epidemiology, country, site, and patient-pool analyses. Translate evidence into clear country, site, enrolment, and operational recommendations. Develop logical, transparent rationales for assumptions and identify important data limitations and feasibility risks. Present feasibility methods, findings, recommendations, and supporting rationale to Business Development colleagues, proposal teams, and clients. Collaborate with internal colleagues, external consultants, data partners, investigators, and sites to gather and interpret feasibility information. Plan, coordinate, and analyse targeted site and investigator outreach, as appropriate. Participate in bid-defence meetings and client discussions. Contribute to the continued development of feasibility methods, data sources, tools, templates, and best practices. Share knowledge and support the development of colleagues within the Feasibility team. Work effectively across functions, therapeutic areas, and geographic regions. Contribute to initiatives that strengthen Precision for Medicine’s scientifically driven approach and client offering.   Required qualifications and experience: Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related discipline. description: Are you looking to work with a dynamic team of industry‑leading professionals in the HEOR space? Are you passionate about keeping complex, evidence‑driven projects running smoothly and delivered to the highest standard? Our Evidence Synthesis & Decision Modelling team at Precision AQ is hiring a Project / Portfolio Manager to support global HEOR programs, with a particular focus on Joint Clinical Assessment (JCA) submissions , systematic literature reviews, statistical analyses, and economic models. This is a highly visible, client‑facing role, partnering with senior scientific leaders to ensure projects are well‑planned, well‑run, and delivered on time and to expectation. About you: You are an experienced project manager with a strong understanding of HEOR‑related deliverables and consulting environments. You thrive in coordinating complex, multi‑workstream projects and enjoy working closely with both internal teams and external clients. You have experience managing timelines and workloads across multiple concurrent projects, translating high‑level objectives into clear, actionable plans, and proactively identifying and resolving risks to delivery. You are confident interacting with clients, supporting project governance, leading project management discussions, and acting as a trusted point of contact for organization, planning, and progress tracking.You are detail‑oriented, highly organized, and comfortable working with scientific and technical teams delivering literature reviews, quantitative analyses, and economic models.   About the Role: As a Project / Portfolio Manager within the Evidence Synthesis & Decision Modelling team, you will work closely with scientific project leads (e.g., Directors, VPs) and cross‑functional contributors across evidence synthesis, statistics, and health economic modelling. You will be responsible for end‑to‑end project management , including planning, resourcing, timeline development, progress tracking, risk management, and delivery oversight across individual projects and portfolios of work (particularly JCA program's). On client‑facing projects, you will support or lead project management discussions, prepare and maintain project plans, timelines, and reports, and ensure clear communication of status, risks, dependencies, and actions. This will involve monitoring scope changes and managing change order processes, clearly documenting impacts on timelines, resources, and budgets. You will ensure projects run smoothly by coordinating internal workflows, facilitating alignment across disciplines, documenting decisions and actions, and supporting monitoring and evaluation of agreed processes and milestones. This will involve coordination of both internal/external review cycle timelines and collating feedback from various external reviewers. You will play a key role in ensuring on‑time delivery, supporting financial and scope tracking, and escalating risks or resourcing issues early to project leadership. You will work with clients to maintain an organized repository of deliverables. You will support strategic portfolio oversight and prioritization, working with senior leadership to balance competing demands, optimize resource allocation, and align project execution with broader organizational and client objectives. You will develop and maintain standardized project management tools and templates, ensuring best practices are applied consistently across projects and teams. This will also involve facilitating cross-project knowledge sharing and lessons learned, helping to improve delivery quality and inform future study design and execution. Where possible, you will leverage project management tools and data to generate insights, enabling data-driven decision-making and transparent reporting for internal stakeholders and clients. Where required, you will also support proposal development and study start‑up activities, including timeline development.   Required Experience: 3+ years of experience in project management, preferably within consulting, life sciences, HEOR, market access, or related environments Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi‑disciplinary projects with multiple stakeholders Experience working in a client‑facing role, supporting or leading project management communications Strong organizational, planning, and time‑management skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously Excellent written and verbal communication skills Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, PowerPoint, Word); familiarity with project tracking tools is an advantage Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a collaborative, cross‑functional team   Helpful Experience: Experience supporting HEOR, evidence synthesis, health economics, modelling, or market access projects Familiarity with JCA submissions, HTA processes, or global evidence strategy programs Experience coordinating work delivered by statisticians, health economists, and systematic review teams Awareness of project financials, resourcing constraints, and scope management A proactive, solutions‑oriented mindset with strong problem‑solving skills High attention to detail and commitment to quality   Who We Are: For today’s innovators of tomorrow’s cures, Precision AQ HEOR , part of Precision Medicine Group LLC, has the results‑driven scientists, strategists, and solutions our clients need to go from promises to proof, and evidence to access. We provide our clients with unified health economics and outcomes research, global pricing and access strategy, analytics, payer and physician insights, and data management. title: Quality & Compliance Manager, Computer System Validation
description: JOB SUMMARY The Quality & Compliance Manager, Computer System Validation manages the quality oversight and lifecycle validation of GxP computerized systems supporting CRO and laboratory operations. The role partners with Quality, IT, system owners, operational teams, and external providers to ensure systems are fit for intended use, maintain data integrity, and remain compliant and inspection-ready from implementation through retirement. The Manager establishes consistent, risk-based computer system assurance practices and drives continuous improvement across clinical and laboratory environments.   MAIN DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES Provide independent, risk-based Quality Assurance oversight of GxP computerized systems throughout the system lifecycle, from initial assessment and implementation through operation, periodic review, significant change, and retirement. Review and approve applicable validation and assurance deliverables, including system risk assessments, validation plans, requirements, traceability documentation, test evidence, deviations, validation summary reports, and release-readiness documentation. Confirm that testing is appropriately planned, executed, documented, and traceable without assuming responsibility for business-owned testing or project execution. Ensure computerized systems are fit for intended use, maintain data integrity, and comply with applicable internal procedures, client commitments, and regulatory requirements, including requirements relevant to electronic records, electronic signatures, audit trails, access controls, security, backup, archival, and record retention. Provide QA oversight for computerized systems supporting clinical research and laboratory activities, including clinical platforms, laboratory information systems, electronic laboratory notebooks, chromatography data systems, instrument software, interfaces, automated workflows, and associated data repositories, as applicable to the role’s scope. Oversee the ongoing validated state of computerized systems by evaluating changes, incidents, deviations, corrective and preventive actions, upgrades, data migrations, periodic reviews, and decommissioning activities. Identify and escalate compliance or data-integrity risks and verify that appropriate remediation is completed and documented Support the qualification and ongoing oversight of software, cloud, data, and computerized-system service providers. Partner with Quality, IT, Information Security, Clinical Operations, Laboratory Operations, system owners, and vendors to clarify accountabilities and ensure that adequate controls are established and maintained. Develop, maintain, and improve policies, procedures, templates, tools, and training for computer system validation and computer software assurance. Promote consistent, scalable, and risk-based practices across CRO and laboratory environments. Prepare for and support sponsor audits, regulatory inspections, and internal audits involving computerized systems. Ensure validation records are complete, accurate, readily retrievable, and inspection-ready, and coordinate responses to observations within the role’s area of responsibility. Establish and report meaningful metrics for validation status, lifecycle compliance, overdue activities, deviations, CAPAs, supplier performance, and emerging risks. Use trends and lessons learned to drive continuous improvement and communicate significant issues to Quality and business leadership. EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE Bachelor’s degree in life sciences, computer science, information systems, engineering, healthcare, or another relevant scientific or technical discipline. A minimum of six years of progressively responsible experience in Quality Assurance, computer system validation, computer software assurance, information technology quality, or related discipline within a regulated life sciences environment. Demonstrated experience providing independent QA oversight of GxP computerized systems throughout the system lifecycle, including initial risk assessment, validation planning, requirements, testing, traceability, release, change control, periodic review, incident management, data migration, and system retirement. Experience reviewing and approving computer system validation or assurance documentation, such as validation plans, system risk assessments, requirements specifications, test plans and evidence, requirements traceability matrices, deviations, validation summary reports, and change-control records. Working knowledge of applicable regulatory requirements and industry expectations, including FDA electronic-record and electronic-signature requirements, EU Annex 11, ICH Good Clinical Practice, Good Laboratory Practice, and data-integrity principles. Experience supporting computerized systems used in CRO, clinical research, or laboratory operations, such as electronic data capture, clinical trial management, electronic trial master file, interactive response technology, laboratory information management, electronic laboratory notebook, chromatography data, quality management, and other GxP-regulated platforms. Experience with risk-based validation and assurance approaches for configurable commercial software, software-as-a-service solutions, hosted platforms, system interfaces, laboratory instrument software, and internally configured or developed solutions. Experience supporting supplier qualification, system or vendor audits, sponsor audits, regulatory inspections, and the assessment and remediation of computerized-system compliance observations. Demonstrated experience working collaboratively with system owners, Information Technology, Information Security, Clinical Operations, Laboratory Operations, Quality Assurance, vendors, and other stakeholders in a matrixed and geographically dispersed organization. Or equivalent combination of education, professional training and experience that provides the individual with the required knowledge, skills, and abilities to perform the job.  Preferred Education and Experience:  Master’s degree in life sciences, computer science, information systems, engineering, quality management, regulatory affairs, or related discipline. Experience working within a contract research organization, regulated laboratory, biotechnology, pharmaceutical, or medical-device organization. Experience providing QA oversight across multiple GxP environments, particularly GCP, GLP, GCLP, and GMP. Experience managing or developing a geographically dispersed or global validation and quality team. Experience with laboratory platforms and instrument software, including LIMS, ELN, CDS, data-acquisition systems, interfaces, and automated laboratory workflows. title: Regulatory and Site Start Up Specialist
description: Precision for Medicine is not your typical CRO.  At Precision for Medicine we have brought together new technologies, expertise and operational scale to help the life sciences improve the speed, cost and success rate of bringing life-changing therapies to patients.  What sets us apart is the way we integrate clinical trial execution with deep scientific knowledge, laboratory expertise and advanced data sciences. We have a strong focus on Oncology and Rare Disease. Due to our continued growth we are seeking a Regulatory and Site Start Up Specialist. The Regulatory and Start Up Specialist (RSS) is an experienced professional in regulatory and site start-up activities. Responsibilities will be dependent upon the location of the RSS and include but are not limited to initial and subsequent clinical trial submission to Competent Authorities and IRB/ Ethics Committees, Informed Consent Form review and adaptation, Essential Document collection and quality review, supporting sites on IRB/EC submissions and provide support to the Site Contract Management group in budget and contract negotiation. The RSS may act as Subject Matter Expert for questions by other in-country members (CRAs, CSSs or others) supporting site start-up activities and may contribute to development or revision of country specific tools and guidance documents to ensure compliance with local and international clinical trials regulations and guidelines. Essential functions of the job include but are not limited to: • Responsible for delivery, in terms of timeliness and quality, of site activation readiness within the assigned country/sites and foreseeing and mitigating any risks. • Preparation of Clinical Trial Application Forms as well as preparation of submission dossier (initial and amendments/notifications) for submission to CA, EC, and other applicable local bodies according to local requirements and within required timelines to obtain all necessary authorizations/approvals for the conduct of the Clinical Trial according to international and local/national applicable regulations, company SOPs and principles of ICH-GCP. • Interaction with CA/EC for study purposes and handling responses to the CA/EC. • Providing regular updates about CA and EC submissions to the Start Up Lead and/or Regulatory Lead assigned to the study and to Project Manager/Project Team as relevant. • Maintenance of project plans, project trackers and regulatory intelligence tools as it pertains to assigned responsibilities and to keep Regulatory Leadership updated. • Preparation/Support the development of study specific start-up plans, IMP release requirements and essential document review criteria. • Partner with the assigned site CRA to ensure alignment in communication and secure site collaboration. • Prepare. review and manage collection of essential documents required for site activation/IMP release. • Customize country/site specific Patient Information Sheet and Informed Consent Forms. • Responsible for/facilitates the translation and co-ordination of translations for documents required for submission. • Maintain communication with other key functions participating to country start up i.e., Feasibility, Clinical Operations, Project Management, Regulatory, and Site Contracts management group on project specific status and deliverables. • Act as SME for collection and maintenance of site level critical path to Site Activation data points, including but not limited to Competent Authority, local IRB/Ethics Committee (EC) timelines, site contracts and budget negotiation requirements for and other required reviews to secure on time site activation for the assigned sites in the country. • When required, participate/support the negotiation of study budgets and the execution of investigator contracts under directions of Site Contract Management department/designee department. • May participate/support feasibility group in site outreach to assess potential interest of investigators to a potential study. • Keep an updated knowledge of the local clinical trial laws, regulations and help distributing their knowledge within PfM to ensure the conduct of Clinical Trials according to international and local/national applicable regulations. • Maintain audit/inspection readiness at all times and file documents as per TMF plan and/ or study specific plans in the relevant TMF • May support the clinical team performing Pre-Study Site Visits. • May support process improvement initiatives, training, and mentoring. • Performs other duties as assigned by management. Requirement: • Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or related field (ideally in a scientific or healthcare discipline), or Registered Nurse (RN) or equivalent combination of education, training, and experience. • 1 year or more as a Regulatory or SU specialist (or comparable role) in either a CRO or pharmaceutical/ biotech industry or equivalent, relevant experience and/or demonstrated competencies. • Strong communication and organizational skills are essential. • Experience using computerized information systems, electronic spreadsheets, word processing and electronic mail required. • Fluency in English and for non-English speaking countries the local language of country where position based.
